verses.kjv: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.modern: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

verses.kjv: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
verses.modern: Hear, O heavens, and listen, O earth, for the LORD has spoken. I have nourished and raised children, and they have rebelled against Me.

verses.kjv: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
verses.modern: The ox knows its owner, and the donkey its master's stall, but Israel does not know; My people do not consider.

verses.kjv: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the LORD, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
verses.modern: A sinful nation, a people loaded down with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children who are corrupters! They have forsaken the LORD; they have provoked the Holy One of Israel to anger; they have turned away backward.

verses.kjv: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
verses.modern: Why should You be struck anymore? You will only rebel more and more. The whole head is sick, and the whole heart is faint.

verses.kjv: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
verses.modern: From the sole of the foot even to the head, there is no soundness in it — only wounds, bruises, and festering sores. They have not been closed, nor bound up, nor soothed with ointment.

verses.kjv: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.modern: Your country is desolate; Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour Your land in Your presence, and it is desolate, as if overthrown by strangers.

verses.kjv: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
verses.modern: The daughter of Zion is left like a hut in a vineyard, like a shelter in a cucumber field, like a besieged city.

verses.kjv: Except the LORD of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
verses.modern: Unless the LORD of hosts had left us a very small remnant, we would have been like Sodom, we would have been like Gomorrah.

verses.kjv: Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
verses.modern: Hear the word of the LORD, You rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

verses.kjv: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the LORD: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
verses.modern: "What is the purpose of all Your sacrifices to Me?" says the LORD. "I am full of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fattened beasts. I do not delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.

verses.kjv: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
verses.modern: When You come to appear before Me, who has required this from Your hand, to trample My courts?

verses.kjv: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
verses.modern: Bring no more empty offerings; incense is detestable to Me. The new moons, the sabbaths, the calling of assemblies — I cannot endure iniquity together with the solemn meeting.

verses.kjv: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
verses.modern: My soul hates Your new moons and Your appointed feasts. They are a burden to Me; I am weary of bearing them.

verses.kjv: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
verses.modern: When You spread out Your hands, I will hide My eyes from You. Even though You make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.

verses.kjv: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
verses.modern: Wash yourselves; make yourselves clean. Put away the evil of Your doings from before My eyes. Stop doing evil.

verses.kjv: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
verses.modern: Learn to do good; seek justice, rebuke the oppressor, defend the fatherless, plead for the widow.

verses.kjv: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.modern: "Come now, let us reason together," says the LORD. "Though Your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

verses.kjv: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
verses.modern: If You are willing and obedient, You shall eat the good of the land;

verses.kjv: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.modern: but if You refuse and rebel, You shall be devoured with the sword." For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.

verses.kjv: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
verses.modern: How the faithful city has become a harlot! It was full of justice; righteousness lodged in her — but now murderers.

verses.kjv: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
verses.modern: Your silver has become dross, Your wine mixed with water.

verses.kjv: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
verses.modern: Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and chases after rewards. They do not defend the fatherless, and the cause of the widow does not come before them.

verses.kjv: Therefore saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
verses.modern: Therefore the Lord, the LORD of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel, declares: "I will rid Myself of My adversaries and avenge Myself on My enemies.

verses.kjv: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
verses.modern: I will turn My hand against You and thoroughly purge away Your dross and remove all Your alloy.

verses.kjv: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
verses.modern: I will restore Your judges as at the first, and Your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward You shall be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful City."

verses.kjv: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
verses.modern: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her penitents with righteousness.

verses.kjv: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
verses.modern: The destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and those who forsake the LORD shall be consumed.

verses.kjv: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
verses.modern: They shall be ashamed of the oaks You have desired, and You shall be embarrassed because of the gardens You have chosen.

verses.kjv: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
verses.modern: For You shall be like an oak whose leaf fades, and like a garden that has no water.

verses.kjv: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
verses.modern: The strong shall be like tinder, and His work like a spark; they shall both burn together, and no one shall quench them.

chapters.summary: The LORD rebukes Judah as a sinful nation whose sacrifices and feasts He despises because their hands are full of blood. He calls them to wash themselves, cease doing evil, and learn to do good, promising that though their sins are as scarlet they shall be white as snow.

verses.kjv: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.modern: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD's house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
verses.modern: In the last days the mountain of the LORD's house shall be established on the highest of the mountains, exalted above the hills. All nations shall flow to it.

verses.kjv: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Many peoples shall come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us his ways, and we will walk in His paths." For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.modern: He shall judge among the nations and rebuke many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation; they shall not learn war anymore.

verses.kjv: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.
verses.modern: O house of Jacob, come, let us walk in the light of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
verses.modern: You have forsaken Your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled with customs from the east. They are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they strike hands with foreigners.

verses.kjv: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
verses.modern: Their land is full of silver and gold; there is no end to their treasures. Their land is full of horses; there is no end to their chariots.

verses.kjv: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
verses.modern: Their land is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, what their own fingers have made.

verses.kjv: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
verses.modern: The lowly man bows down, and the great man humbles himself — so do not forgive them.

verses.kjv: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.
verses.modern: Hide in the rock; take cover in the dust, from the terror of the LORD and the glory of His majesty.

verses.kjv: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.modern: The proud looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men bowed down. The LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

verses.kjv: For the day of the LORD of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
verses.modern: For the day of the LORD of hosts shall come against everyone proud and lofty, against everyone lifted up — and He shall be brought low —

verses.kjv: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.modern: against all the cedars of Lebanon that are high and lifted up, and against all the oaks of Bashan,

verses.kjv: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
verses.modern: against all the high mountains, and against all the hills that are lifted up,

verses.kjv: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
verses.modern: against every high tower and every fortified wall,

verses.kjv: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
verses.modern: against all the ships of Tarshish and all the beautiful vessels.

verses.kjv: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.modern: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men made low. The LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

verses.kjv: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
verses.modern: He shall utterly abolish the idols.

verses.kjv: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.modern: People shall go into the holes of the rocks and into the caves of the earth, from the terror of the LORD and the glory of His majesty, when He rises to shake the earth terribly.

verses.kjv: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
verses.modern: In that day a man shall throw away his idols of silver and his idols of gold — which He made for Himself to worship — to the moles and to the bats,

verses.kjv: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.modern: to flee into the clefts of the rocks and the crags, from the terror of the LORD and the glory of His majesty, when He rises to shake the earth terribly.

verses.kjv: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?
verses.modern: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils. What is He worth?

chapters.summary: Isaiah prophesies that in the last days the mountain of the LORD's house will be exalted above the hills and all nations will flow to it. The LORD will judge among the nations and they will beat their swords into plowshares. He warns that the day of the LORD will bring low every proud and lofty thing.

verses.kjv: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,
verses.modern: The Lord, the LORD of hosts, is removing from Jerusalem and from Judah all support — the entire supply of bread and the entire supply of water —

verses.kjv: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
verses.modern: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, and the elder,

verses.kjv: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
verses.modern: the captain of fifty, the man of rank, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the eloquent speaker.

verses.kjv: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
verses.modern: "I will give them children as their princes, and infants shall rule over them.

verses.kjv: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
verses.modern: The people shall oppress one another — each man his neighbor. The young shall act arrogantly against the elder, and the lowly against the honorable."

verses.kjv: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:
verses.modern: When a man grabs his brother in his father's house and says, "You have a coat — you be our ruler! Let this ruin be under your hand,"

verses.kjv: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
verses.modern: in that day he will protest: "I will not be a healer. In my house there is neither bread nor coat. Do not make me ruler of the people."

verses.kjv: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
verses.modern: Jerusalem has stumbled, and Judah has fallen, because their speech and their deeds are against the LORD, provoking His glorious presence.

verses.kjv: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
verses.modern: The look on their faces testifies against them. They declare their sin like Sodom and do not hide it. Woe to them, for they have brought disaster on themselves!

verses.kjv: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
verses.modern: Tell the righteous that it will go well with them, for they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.

verses.kjv: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
verses.modern: Woe to the wicked! It will go badly for them, for what their hands have done will be done to them.

verses.kjv: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
verses.modern: As for My people, children oppress them, and women rule over them. O My people, your guides lead you astray and confuse the direction of your paths.

verses.kjv: The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
verses.modern: The LORD rises to argue His case; He stands to judge the peoples.

verses.kjv: The LORD will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.
verses.modern: The LORD enters into judgment with the elders and princes of His people: "You have devoured the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in Your houses.

verses.kjv: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
verses.modern: What do You mean by crushing My people and grinding the faces of the poor?" declares the Lord GOD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Moreover the LORD saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
verses.modern: The LORD also says: "Because the daughters of Zion are proud and walk with their necks stretched out and their eyes flirting, strutting and mincing as they go, with jingling ornaments on their feet,

verses.kjv: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will discover their secret parts.
verses.modern: therefore the Lord will strike the scalp of the daughters of Zion with sores, and the LORD will lay their foreheads bare."

verses.kjv: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
verses.modern: In that day the Lord will take away the finery of their ankle chains, their headbands, and their crescent necklaces,

verses.kjv: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
verses.modern: the pendants, the bracelets, and the veils,

verses.kjv: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
verses.modern: the headdresses, the leg ornaments, the sashes, the perfume boxes, and the amulets,

verses.kjv: The rings, and nose jewels,
verses.modern: the rings and the nose jewels,

verses.kjv: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
verses.modern: the fine robes, the cloaks, the shawls, and the handbags,

verses.kjv: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
verses.modern: the mirrors, the fine linen garments, the turbans, and the long veils.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.
verses.modern: Instead of sweet perfume there will be a stench. Instead of a sash, a rope. Instead of styled hair, baldness. Instead of a rich robe, a garment of sackcloth. And a brand instead of beauty.

verses.kjv: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
verses.modern: Your men shall fall by the sword and Your warriors in battle.

verses.kjv: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
verses.modern: Her gates shall mourn and grieve, and she shall sit desolate on the ground.

chapters.summary: The LORD declares He will remove from Jerusalem every supply and stay -- the mighty man, the judge, the prophet, and the elder. Children will rule over them and the people will oppress one another. The daughters of Zion are warned that their finery will be replaced with sackcloth and shame.

verses.kjv: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.
verses.modern: In that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, "We will eat our own bread and wear our own clothes — only let us be called by Your name; take away our shame."

verses.kjv: In that day shall the branch of the LORD be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.
verses.modern: In that day the Branch of the LORD shall be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land shall be the pride and glory of the survivors of Israel.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:
verses.modern: It shall come to pass that He who is left in Zion and remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy — everyone recorded among the living in Jerusalem —

verses.kjv: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
verses.modern: when the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and cleansed the bloodstains of Jerusalem from its midst by a spirit of judgment and by a spirit of burning.

verses.kjv: And the LORD will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.
verses.modern: Then the LORD will create over every home on Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud of smoke by day and a bright flame of fire by night. Over all the glory there will be a canopy.

verses.kjv: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge and for a covert from storm and from rain.
verses.modern: There shall be a shelter for shade from the heat by day, and a refuge and hiding place from the storm and rain.

chapters.summary: Isaiah prophesies that in that day seven women will take hold of one man. The Branch of the LORD will be beautiful and glorious for the survivors of Israel, and the LORD will create over Mount Zion a cloud by day and a fire by night as a covering of glory.

verses.kjv: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
verses.modern: Let me sing for my beloved a love song about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fertile hill.

verses.kjv: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
verses.modern: He dug it up and cleared it of stones, and planted it with the choicest vines. He built a watchtower in the middle of it and cut out a wine vat. He expected it to yield good grapes — but it yielded wild grapes.

verses.kjv: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
verses.modern: "Now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, judge between me and my vineyard.

verses.kjv: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
verses.modern: What more could have been done for my vineyard that I have not done? When I expected it to yield good grapes, why did it yield wild grapes?

verses.kjv: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
verses.modern: Now let me tell You what I will do to my vineyard. I will remove its hedge, and it shall be devoured. I will break down its wall, and it shall be trampled down.

verses.kjv: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
verses.modern: I will make it a wasteland — unpruned and unweeded — and briers and thorns shall come up. I will also command the clouds to rain no rain on it."

verses.kjv: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
verses.modern: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah are His pleasant planting. He looked for justice, but found bloodshed; for righteousness, but heard a cry of distress.

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
verses.modern: Woe to those who join house to house, who add field to field, until there is no room left, and You alone live in the midst of the land!

verses.kjv: In mine ears said the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
verses.modern: The LORD of hosts said in my hearing, "Many houses shall be desolate — great and fine ones, with no one living in them."

verses.kjv: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
verses.modern: Ten acres of vineyard shall produce only one bath of wine, and a homer of seed shall yield only an ephah of grain.

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!
verses.modern: Woe to those who rise early in the morning to run after strong drink, who stay up late into the night until wine inflames them!

verses.kjv: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.
verses.modern: They have lyre and harp, tambourine and flute, and wine at their feasts — but they do not regard the work of the LORD, nor consider what His hands have done.

verses.kjv: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
verses.modern: Therefore My people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honored men are starving and their crowd is parched with thirst.

verses.kjv: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
verses.modern: Therefore hell has enlarged its appetite and opened its mouth beyond measure. Their glory, their crowd, their pomp, and all who rejoice among them descend into it.

verses.kjv: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
verses.modern: The lowly shall be brought down, the mighty humbled, and the eyes of the proud brought low.

verses.kjv: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
verses.modern: But the LORD of hosts is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One shows Himself holy in righteousness.

verses.kjv: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
verses.modern: Then lambs shall graze as in their pasture, and strangers shall eat among the ruins of the rich.

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
verses.modern: Woe to those who drag iniquity along with cords of deceit, and sin as if pulling it with a cart rope,

verses.kjv: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
verses.modern: who say, "Let Him hurry and hasten His work so we can see it! Let the plan of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come so we can know it!"

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
verses.modern: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter!

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
verses.modern: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes and clever in their own sight!

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
verses.modern: Woe to those who are heroes at drinking wine, champions at mixing strong drink,

verses.kjv: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
verses.modern: who acquit the guilty for a bribe and deny justice to the innocent!

verses.kjv: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.modern: Therefore, as a flame devours stubble and dry grass collapses into the fire, their root shall rot and their blossom blow away as dust — because they have rejected the law of the LORD of hosts and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.modern: Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against His people. He stretched out His hand against them and struck them. The mountains trembled, and their corpses lay like refuse in the streets. Yet for all this His anger has not turned away; His hand is still stretched out.

verses.kjv: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
verses.modern: He raises an ensign for distant nations and whistles for them from the ends of the earth. They come quickly, with great speed.

verses.kjv: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
verses.modern: None among them is weary or stumbles. None slumbers or sleeps. Their belts are not loosened; their sandal straps are not broken.

verses.kjv: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
verses.modern: Their arrows are sharp and their bows strung. Their horses' hooves are like flint, and their chariot wheels like a whirlwind.

verses.kjv: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.
verses.modern: Their roaring is like a lion; they roar like young lions. They growl, seize the prey, and carry it off, with no one to rescue it.

verses.kjv: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
verses.modern: In that day they shall roar over them like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land — darkness and distress. The light is darkened by the clouds.

chapters.summary: Isaiah sings the parable of the LORD's vineyard, which He planted and tended but which yielded only wild grapes. The LORD pronounces six woes -- against those who join house to house, who rise early to follow strong drink, who call evil good and good evil, who are wise in their own eyes, and who justify the wicked for a bribe.

verses.kjv: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
verses.modern: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up, and the train of His robe filled the temple.

verses.kjv: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
verses.modern: Above Him stood the seraphim. Each had six wings: with two he covered his face, with two he covered his feet, and with two he flew.

verses.kjv: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
verses.modern: One called to another and said, "Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts; the whole earth is full of His glory!"

verses.kjv: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.modern: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of Him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: I said, "Woe is me! I am ruined, for I am a man of unclean lips, and I live among a people of unclean lips — yet my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts!"

verses.kjv: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
verses.modern: Then one of the seraphim flew to me with a burning coal in His hand, which He had taken from the altar with tongs.

verses.kjv: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.
verses.modern: He touched my mouth with it and said, "This has touched Your lips; Your iniquity is taken away and Your sin purged."

verses.kjv: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
verses.modern: I heard the voice of the Lord saying, "Whom shall I send, and who will go for Us?" I said, "Here I am. Send me."

verses.kjv: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
verses.modern: He said, "Go, and tell this people: 'Keep listening, but do not understand. Keep looking, but do not see.'

verses.kjv: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
verses.modern: Make the heart of this people dull, make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes — lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn and be healed."

verses.kjv: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
verses.modern: I said, "Lord, how long?" He answered, "Until cities lie waste without inhabitant, and houses without man, and the land is utterly desolate,

verses.kjv: And the LORD have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.
verses.modern: and the LORD has removed people far away, and the forsaken places are many in the midst of the land.

verses.kjv: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.
verses.modern: Yet a tenth shall remain in it, and it will be burned again, like a terebinth or an oak whose stump remains when it is felled. The holy seed is its stump."

chapters.summary: Isaiah sees the Lord sitting on His throne, high and lifted up, with the seraphim crying, 'Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts.' Isaiah cries out that he is undone as a man of unclean lips. A seraph touches his lips with a live coal from the altar, and the LORD commissions him to preach to a people who will hear but not understand.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
verses.modern: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, came up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not defeat it.

verses.kjv: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
verses.modern: When the house of David was told, "Syria is allied with Ephraim," the heart of Ahaz and the heart of his people shook as the trees of the forest shake before the wind.

verses.kjv: Then said the LORD unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shearjashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field;
verses.modern: The LORD said to Isaiah, "Go out to meet Ahaz, you and your son Shearjashub, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool on the road to the field of the launderer.

verses.kjv: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
verses.modern: Tell Him: 'Be careful, stay calm, and do not be afraid. Do not let Your heart grow faint because of these two smoldering stubs of torches — the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria and the son of Remaliah.

verses.kjv: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
verses.modern: Because Syria, with Ephraim and the son of Remaliah, has plotted evil against You, saying,

verses.kjv: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:
verses.modern: "Let us go up against Judah and terrify it, and let us conquer it for ourselves and set up the son of Tabeal as king in the midst of it" —

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
verses.modern: thus says the Lord GOD: It shall not stand, and it shall not come to pass.

verses.kjv: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
verses.modern: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim will be shattered so that it is no longer a people.

verses.kjv: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
verses.modern: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If You will not believe, You will not be established.' "

verses.kjv: Moreover the LORD spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to Ahaz again, saying,

verses.kjv: Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
verses.modern: "Ask a sign of the LORD Your God — let it be as deep as the grave or as high as heaven."

verses.kjv: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the LORD.
verses.modern: But Ahaz said, "I will not ask, and I will not put the LORD to the test."

verses.kjv: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?
verses.modern: Isaiah said, "Hear then, O house of David! Is it too small a thing for you to weary men, that you must weary my God also?

verses.kjv: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.modern: Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign. A virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and shall call His name Immanuel.

verses.kjv: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
verses.modern: He shall eat curds and honey when He knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.

verses.kjv: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.
verses.modern: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you dread will be deserted.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.
verses.modern: The LORD will bring on You, on Your people, and on Your father's house, days such as have not come since the day that Ephraim departed from Judah — the king of Assyria."

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.modern: In that day the LORD will whistle for the fly that is in the far rivers of Egypt and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

verses.kjv: And they shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
verses.modern: They shall all come and settle in the steep ravines, and in the clefts of the rocks, and on all the thornbushes, and on all the watering holes.

verses.kjv: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
verses.modern: In that day the Lord will shave with a hired razor — with those beyond the River, with the king of Assyria — the head and the hair of the legs. It will sweep away the beard also.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
verses.modern: In that day a man will keep alive a young cow and two sheep.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
verses.modern: Because of the abundance of milk they give, he shall eat curds. Everyone left in the land will eat curds and honey.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.
verses.modern: In that day every place where there used to be a thousand vines worth a thousand pieces of silver shall become briers and thorns.

verses.kjv: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
verses.modern: Men will come there with bows and arrows, for all the land will be briers and thorns.

verses.kjv: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
verses.modern: As for all the hills that used to be worked with a hoe, you will not go there for fear of briers and thorns. They will be places for oxen to roam and for sheep to trample.

chapters.summary: The LORD sends Isaiah to King Ahaz during the Syro-Ephraimite crisis to tell him not to fear Rezin and Pekah. Ahaz refuses to ask for a sign, so the LORD gives one Himself: a virgin shall conceive and bear a son and call his name Immanuel. Before the child is old enough to know good from evil, both enemy kings will be forsaken.

verses.kjv: Moreover the LORD said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Mahershalalhashbaz.
verses.modern: The LORD said to me, "Take a large scroll and write on it in common script: Mahershalalhashbaz."

verses.kjv: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
verses.modern: I had it witnessed by Uriah the priest and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah, reliable witnesses.

verses.kjv: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Mahershalalhashbaz.
verses.modern: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived and bore a son. The LORD said to me, "Call His name Mahershalalhashbaz.

verses.kjv: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.
verses.modern: For before the boy knows how to say 'My father' or 'My mother,' the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria shall be carried off before the king of Assyria."

verses.kjv: The LORD spake also unto me again, saying,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;
verses.modern: "Because this people has rejected the waters of Shiloah that flow gently, and rejoice in Rezin and the son of Remaliah,

verses.kjv: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
verses.modern: therefore the Lord is about to bring up against them the waters of the River — mighty and many — the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will rise over all its channels and overflow all its banks.

verses.kjv: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
verses.modern: It shall sweep on into Judah, overflow, and pass through. It shall reach even to the neck, and its outspread wings shall fill the breadth of your land, O Immanuel."

verses.kjv: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.
verses.modern: Band together, O peoples, and be shattered! Listen, all you distant lands. Prepare for battle, and be shattered! Prepare for battle, and be shattered!

verses.kjv: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.
verses.modern: Devise a plan — it will come to nothing. State your case — it will not stand. For God is with us.

verses.kjv: For the LORD spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
verses.modern: For the LORD spoke to me with a strong hand and warned me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,

verses.kjv: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
verses.modern: "Do not call 'conspiracy' everything this people calls a conspiracy. Do not fear what they fear or be in dread of it.

verses.kjv: Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
verses.modern: The LORD of hosts — regard Him as holy. Let Him be Your fear and Your dread.

verses.kjv: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: He will be a sanctuary, but also a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense to both houses of Israel — a trap and a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
verses.modern: Many shall stumble over it; they shall fall and be broken, be snared and taken."

verses.kjv: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
verses.modern: Bind up the testimony; seal the law among my disciples.

verses.kjv: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
verses.modern: I will wait for the LORD, Who is hiding His face from the house of Jacob, and I will hope in him.

verses.kjv: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.
verses.modern: I and the children the LORD has given me are signs and wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, who dwells on Mount Zion.

verses.kjv: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?
verses.modern: When they say to You, "Seek those who have familiar spirits, and wizards that peep and mutter" — should not a people seek their God? Why consult the dead on behalf of the living?

verses.kjv: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.
verses.modern: To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.

verses.kjv: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.
verses.modern: They shall roam through the land, distressed and starving. When they are hungry, they will grow angry and curse their king and their God, looking upward.

verses.kjv: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.
verses.modern: They shall look to the earth and see only distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They are driven into thick darkness.

chapters.summary: The LORD instructs Isaiah to write on a great tablet the name Mahershalalhashbaz, and Isaiah's wife bears a son by that name as a sign that Assyria will plunder Damascus and Samaria. Isaiah warns the people not to fear man but to sanctify the LORD as their fear. He and his children are for signs and wonders in Israel.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
verses.modern: But the gloom will not stay where there was distress. In the former time He treated the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali with contempt, but in the latter time He will make glorious the way of the sea, the land beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

verses.kjv: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
verses.modern: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. Those who lived in a land of deep darkness — a light has shone on them.

verses.kjv: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
verses.modern: You have multiplied the nation and increased its joy. They rejoice before You as with joy at the harvest, as men are glad when they divide the plunder.

verses.kjv: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.
verses.modern: For the yoke of His burden, the staff on His shoulder, and the rod of His oppressor — You have broken these, as on the day of Midian.

verses.kjv: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.
verses.modern: Every boot of the warrior in battle noise and every garment rolled in blood shall be burned as fuel for fire.

verses.kjv: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
verses.modern: For to us a Child is born, to us a Son is given. The government shall be on His shoulder, and His name shall be called Wonderful, Counselor, The Mighty God, The Everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

verses.kjv: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.
verses.modern: Of the increase of His government and of peace there shall be no end — on the throne of David and over his kingdom, to establish it and uphold it with justice and righteousness from this time forth and forever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will accomplish this.

verses.kjv: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
verses.modern: The Lord has sent a word against Jacob, and it will fall on Israel.

verses.kjv: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
verses.modern: All the people shall know — Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria — who say in pride and arrogance of heart,

verses.kjv: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.
verses.modern: "The bricks have fallen, but we will rebuild with dressed stone. The sycamores have been cut down, but we will replace them with cedars."

verses.kjv: Therefore the LORD shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;
verses.modern: The LORD raises the adversaries of Rezin against them and stirs up their enemies —

verses.kjv: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.modern: Syria on the east and Philistia on the west, and they devour Israel with open mouth. For all this His anger has not turned away; His hand is still stretched out.

verses.kjv: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: Yet the people do not turn to him who struck them, nor seek the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.
verses.modern: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day —

verses.kjv: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
verses.modern: the elder and honored man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.

verses.kjv: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.
verses.modern: The leaders of this people lead them astray, and those they lead are swallowed up.

verses.kjv: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.modern: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, nor have mercy on their fatherless and widows, for everyone is godless and wicked, and every mouth speaks foolishness. For all this His anger has not turned away; His hand is still stretched out.

verses.kjv: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.
verses.modern: For wickedness burns like a fire; it devours briers and thorns. It kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.

verses.kjv: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
verses.modern: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts the land is scorched, and the people are like fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.

verses.kjv: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
verses.modern: They slice on the right and are still hungry; they devour on the left and are not satisfied. Each devours the flesh of His own arm —

verses.kjv: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.modern: Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim devours Manasseh; together they are against Judah. For all this His anger has not turned away; His hand is still stretched out.

chapters.summary: Isaiah prophesies that the people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. A child is born whose name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace, and of His government and peace there shall be no end upon the throne of David. The LORD's anger against Israel is not yet turned away because the people do not repent.

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;
verses.modern: Woe to those who enact unjust laws and issue oppressive rulings,

verses.kjv: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!
verses.modern: to deprive the poor of justice and rob the needy among My people of their rights — so that widows become their prey and they plunder the fatherless!

verses.kjv: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?
verses.modern: What will You do on the day of punishment, when disaster comes from afar? To whom will You flee for help? Where will You leave Your wealth?

verses.kjv: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.modern: Nothing remains but to crouch among the prisoners or fall among the slain. For all this His anger has not turned away; His hand is still stretched out.

verses.kjv: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.
verses.modern: Woe to Assyria, the rod of My anger — the staff in their hand is My fury!

verses.kjv: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.modern: I send Him against a godless nation; I command Him against the people of My wrath, to plunder and to take the spoil, and to trample them down like mud in the streets.

verses.kjv: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
verses.modern: But He does not intend this, nor does His heart think this way — his plan is to destroy and cut off many nations.

verses.kjv: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?
verses.modern: For He says, "Are not all my commanders kings?

verses.kjv: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?
verses.modern: Is not Calno like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad? Is not Samaria like Damascus?

verses.kjv: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
verses.modern: As my hand has reached the kingdoms of the idols, whose carved images were greater than those of Jerusalem and Samaria —

verses.kjv: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
verses.modern: shall I not do to Jerusalem and her idols what I did to Samaria and her idols?"

verses.kjv: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.
verses.modern: When the Lord has finished all His work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, He will punish the boastful heart of the king of Assyria and his proud eyes.

verses.kjv: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:
verses.modern: For he says, "By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I removed the boundaries of peoples, plundered their treasures, and like a warrior brought down those who sat on thrones."

verses.kjv: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.
verses.modern: My hand found the wealth of the peoples as one finds a bird's nest. As one gathers abandoned eggs, I gathered all the earth. Not one wing fluttered, not a mouth opened, not a peep was heard."

verses.kjv: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.
verses.modern: Shall the axe boast over him who swings it? Shall the saw magnify itself against him who wields it? That would be like a rod wielding the one who lifts it — like a staff lifting up a man who is not wood!

verses.kjv: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.
verses.modern: Therefore the Lord, the LORD of hosts, will send wasting sickness among His stout warriors; under His glory a fire will be kindled, burning like a blazing flame.

verses.kjv: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;
verses.modern: The Light of Israel shall become a fire, and His Holy One a flame. It shall burn and devour His thorns and briers in one day.

verses.kjv: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.
verses.modern: It will destroy the glory of His forest and His fruitful land, both soul and body, and it will be as when a sick man wastes away.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.
verses.modern: The remaining trees of His forest will be so few that a child could count them.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.modern: In that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no longer lean on him who struck them, but will truly lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
verses.modern: A remnant shall return — the remnant of Jacob — to the Mighty God.

verses.kjv: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.
verses.modern: Though your people Israel be as the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them shall return. Destruction is decreed, overflowing with righteousness.

verses.kjv: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
verses.modern: For the Lord GOD of hosts will carry out a full destruction — as decreed — throughout the land.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
verses.modern: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD of hosts: O My people who live in Zion, do not be afraid of the Assyrian. He strikes you with the rod and lifts His staff against You as Egypt did.

verses.kjv: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.
verses.modern: In just a little while My fury will be spent, and My anger will turn to their destruction.

verses.kjv: And the LORD of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
verses.modern: The LORD of hosts will brandish a whip against Him, as He struck Midian at the rock of Oreb. His staff will be over the sea, and He will lift it as He did in Egypt.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
verses.modern: In that day His burden will depart from Your shoulder, and His yoke from Your neck. The yoke will be broken because You have grown fat.

verses.kjv: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
verses.modern: He has come to Aiath; He has passed through Migron; at Michmash He stores His supplies.

verses.kjv: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
verses.modern: They have crossed the pass; at Geba they make their camp for the night. Ramah trembles; Gibeah of Saul has fled.

verses.kjv: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.
verses.modern: Cry out, O daughter of Gallim! Listen, O Laishah! Answer her, O Anathoth!

verses.kjv: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
verses.modern: Madmenah is in flight; the inhabitants of Gebim seek refuge.

verses.kjv: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
verses.modern: This very day he halts at Nob; he shakes his fist at the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.
verses.modern: The Lord, the LORD of hosts, will lop off the boughs with terrifying power. The tall trees shall be cut down; the lofty shall be brought low.

verses.kjv: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
verses.modern: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with an axe, and Lebanon shall fall by the Mighty One.

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounces woe on those who decree unrighteous decrees and rob the poor of their rights. He will use Assyria as the rod of His anger against Israel, but afterward He will punish the king of Assyria for his arrogance. A remnant of Israel will return and lean on the LORD in truth.

verses.kjv: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
verses.modern: A shoot shall come from the stump of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow from His roots.

verses.kjv: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD;
verses.modern: The Spirit of the LORD shall rest on Him — the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and might, the Spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
verses.modern: His delight shall be in the fear of the LORD. He shall not judge by what His eyes see, nor decide by what His ears hear,

verses.kjv: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
verses.modern: but with righteousness He shall judge the poor, and decide with fairness for the meek of the earth. He shall strike the earth with the rod of His mouth, and with the breath of His lips He shall slay the wicked.

verses.kjv: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
verses.modern: Righteousness shall be the belt of His waist, and faithfulness the belt of His hips.

verses.kjv: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
verses.modern: The wolf shall live with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the young goat. The calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf shall be together, and a little child shall lead them.

verses.kjv: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
verses.modern: The cow and the bear shall graze together; their young shall lie down together. The lion shall eat straw like the ox.

verses.kjv: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.
verses.modern: The nursing child shall play over the hole of the cobra, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the adder's den.

verses.kjv: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.modern: They shall not hurt or destroy in all My holy mountain, for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.

verses.kjv: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.
verses.modern: In that day the Root of Jesse shall stand as an ensign for the peoples. The nations shall seek him, and his resting place shall be glorious.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
verses.modern: In that day the Lord shall reach out His hand a second time to recover the remnant of His people — from Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Cush, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and from the coastlands of the sea.

verses.kjv: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
verses.modern: He shall set up an ensign for the nations and assemble the banished of Israel. He shall gather the scattered of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

verses.kjv: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
verses.modern: The envy of Ephraim shall depart, and the enemies of Judah shall be cut off. Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not trouble Ephraim.

verses.kjv: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
verses.modern: They shall swoop down on the shoulder of the Philistines to the west; together they shall plunder the people of the east. They shall reach out their hands against Edom and Moab, and the Ammonites shall obey them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.
verses.modern: The LORD will dry up the tongue of the Sea of Egypt, and wave His hand over the River with His scorching breath. He will strike it into seven channels, and people will cross over on sandals.

verses.kjv: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: There shall be a highway for the remnant of His people remaining from Assyria — as there was for Israel on the day they came up out of Egypt.

chapters.summary: Isaiah prophesies that a rod shall come forth from the stem of Jesse and a Branch shall grow out of his roots. The Spirit of the LORD shall rest upon Him, and He shall judge the poor with righteousness. The wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.

verses.kjv: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
verses.modern: In that day You will say, "I will praise You, O LORD. Though You were angry with me, Your anger turned away, and You comforted me.

verses.kjv: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
verses.modern: God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; He has become my salvation."

verses.kjv: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.modern: With joy You will draw water from the wells of salvation.

verses.kjv: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
verses.modern: In that day You will say, "Give thanks to the LORD! Call upon His name. Make known His deeds among the peoples; declare that His name is exalted.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
verses.modern: Sing to the LORD, for He has done glorious things. Let this be known throughout all the earth.

verses.kjv: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
verses.modern: Shout and sing for joy, O inhabitant of Zion, for great in Your midst is the Holy One of Israel!"

chapters.summary: Isaiah gives a song of praise for the day of salvation. The redeemed will say, 'O LORD, I will praise You; though You were angry with me, Your anger is turned away.' They will draw water with joy from the wells of salvation and declare the LORD's doings among the peoples.

verses.kjv: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
verses.modern: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.

verses.kjv: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
verses.modern: Lift up an ensign on the bare mountain; call out to them. Wave the hand so they may enter the gates of the nobles.

verses.kjv: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.
verses.modern: I have commanded My consecrated ones. I have summoned My warriors to carry out My anger — those who exult in My majesty.

verses.kjv: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
verses.modern: A noise of a crowd on the mountains — like that of a great people! A tumult of kingdoms, of nations gathering! The LORD of hosts is mustering an army for battle.

verses.kjv: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.modern: They come from a far country, from the end of the heavens — the LORD and the weapons of His indignation — to destroy the whole land.
