verses.kjv: Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
verses.modern: Wail, for the day of the LORD is near! It shall come as destruction from the Almighty.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:
verses.modern: Therefore all hands shall grow faint and every man's heart melt.

verses.kjv: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
verses.modern: They shall be terrified. Pangs and agony shall seize them. They shall writhe like a woman in labor. They shall look at one another in shock; their faces shall be ablaze.

verses.kjv: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
verses.modern: The day of the LORD comes — cruel, with fury and burning anger — to make the land a desolation. He will destroy its sinners from it.

verses.kjv: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
verses.modern: For the stars of heaven and their constellations shall not give their light. The sun shall be dark at its rising, and the moon shall not shine its light.

verses.kjv: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
verses.modern: I will punish the world for its evil and the wicked for their iniquity. I will put an end to the arrogance of the proud and lay low the haughtiness of the ruthless.

verses.kjv: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
verses.modern: I will make men scarcer than fine gold — rarer than the gold of Ophir.

verses.kjv: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.modern: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth will move out of its place, at the wrath of the LORD of hosts and in the day of His fierce anger.

verses.kjv: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
verses.modern: Like a hunted gazelle or a flock with no one to gather them, everyone shall turn to his own people and flee to His own land.

verses.kjv: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
verses.modern: Everyone who is found will be stabbed through; everyone who is caught will fall by the sword.

verses.kjv: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
verses.modern: Their infants shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be plundered and their wives violated.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
verses.modern: I am stirring up the Medes against them — they have no regard for silver and no delight in gold.

verses.kjv: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
verses.modern: Their bows shall cut down young men. They shall have no compassion on the fruit of the womb; their eyes shall not pity children.

verses.kjv: And Babylon, that glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.modern: Babylon — the glory of kingdoms, the splendor and pride of the Chaldeans — shall be like Sodom and Gomorrah when God overthrew them.

verses.kjv: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
verses.modern: It shall never be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation. No Arab shall pitch a tent there; no shepherd shall rest his flock there.

verses.kjv: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
verses.modern: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there, and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures. Owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.

verses.kjv: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
verses.modern: The wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.

chapters.summary: Isaiah pronounces the burden against Babylon. The LORD musters an army for the day of His wrath, which will come as destruction from the Almighty. Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, will be overthrown as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and will never be inhabited again.

verses.kjv: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
verses.modern: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob and will again choose Israel and settle them in their own land. Foreigners will join them and attach themselves to the house of Jacob.

verses.kjv: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
verses.modern: The peoples will take them and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them as servants in the LORD's land. They shall take captive those who were their captors and rule over those who oppressed them.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
verses.modern: In the day the LORD gives You rest from Your pain, Your turmoil, and the hard service You were forced to do,

verses.kjv: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
verses.modern: you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon: "How the oppressor has ceased, the fury ended!

verses.kjv: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
verses.modern: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of rulers,

verses.kjv: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.
verses.modern: that struck the peoples in anger with unceasing blows, that ruled the nations in fury with relentless persecution.

verses.kjv: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
verses.modern: The whole earth is at rest and quiet; they break forth into singing.

verses.kjv: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
verses.modern: Even the cypress trees rejoice over You, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, 'Since You were laid low, no woodcutter comes up against us.'

verses.kjv: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
verses.modern: Hell beneath is stirred up to meet You when You come; it rouses the spirits of the dead for You — all the leaders of the earth. It raises from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

verses.kjv: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
verses.modern: All of them will speak and say to You, 'Have You also become weak as we? Have You become like us?'

verses.kjv: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
verses.modern: Your pride has been brought down to hell, along with the music of Your harps. Maggots are Your bed below, and worms cover You."

verses.kjv: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
verses.modern: "How You have fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! How You have been cut down to the ground — you who weakened the nations!

verses.kjv: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
verses.modern: You said in Your heart, 'I will ascend to heaven; I will raise my throne above the stars of God. I will sit on the mount of assembly, on the heights of the north.

verses.kjv: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
verses.modern: I will ascend above the tops of the clouds; I will be like the Most High.'

verses.kjv: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
verses.modern: But You are brought down to hell, to the far reaches of the pit."

verses.kjv: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
verses.modern: Those who see you shall stare at you and ponder over you: "Is this the man who made the earth tremble, who shook kingdoms,

verses.kjv: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?
verses.modern: who made the world like a wilderness and tore down its cities, who did not let his prisoners go home?"

verses.kjv: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
verses.modern: All the kings of the nations lie in honor, each in his own tomb.

verses.kjv: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
verses.modern: But you are cast out of your tomb like a rejected branch, clothed with the slain — with those who are pierced by the sword — who go down to the stones of the pit, like a trampled corpse.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
verses.modern: You will not be joined with them in burial, because you destroyed your land and killed your people. The seed of evildoers shall never be mentioned again.

verses.kjv: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
verses.modern: Prepare a place to slaughter his sons for the iniquity of their fathers! They shall not rise to possess the earth or fill the face of the world with cities.

verses.kjv: For I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "I will rise up against them," says the LORD of hosts. "I will cut off from Babylon name and remnant, offspring and descendants," says the LORD.

verses.kjv: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: "I will make it a possession of the bittern and pools of water. I will sweep it with the besom of destruction," says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
verses.modern: The LORD of hosts has sworn: "As I have planned, so shall it be. As I have purposed, so shall it stand:

verses.kjv: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
verses.modern: I will break the Assyrian in My land, and on My mountains trample Him underfoot. His yoke shall depart from them, and His burden from their shoulder."

verses.kjv: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
verses.modern: This is the purpose purposed for the whole earth; this is the hand stretched out over all the nations.

verses.kjv: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
verses.modern: For the LORD of hosts has purposed, and who can annul it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?

verses.kjv: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
verses.modern: In the year that King Ahaz died, this burden came:

verses.kjv: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
verses.modern: Do not rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, that the rod that struck you is broken. For from the root of the serpent shall come a viper, and its fruit shall be a flying fiery serpent.

verses.kjv: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
verses.modern: The firstborn of the poor shall graze, and the needy shall lie down in safety. But I will kill your root with famine, and it shall slay your remnant.

verses.kjv: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.
verses.modern: Wail, O gate! Cry out, O city! You are melting away, O Philistia, all of you! For smoke comes from the north, and there is no straggler in its ranks.

verses.kjv: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
verses.modern: What will one answer the messengers of the nations? That the LORD has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of His people find refuge.

chapters.summary: The LORD will have mercy on Jacob and set Israel in their own land. Israel will take up a taunt against the king of Babylon, who said in his heart he would ascend above the stars of God. He will be brought down to hell. The LORD also declares judgment against Assyria and Philistia.

verses.kjv: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;
verses.modern: The burden of Moab. In a night Ar of Moab is laid waste and reduced to silence. In a night Kir of Moab is laid waste and reduced to silence.

verses.kjv: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.
verses.modern: They go up to the temple, to Dibon and the high places to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Every head is shaved and every beard cut off.

verses.kjv: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.
verses.modern: In their streets they put on sackcloth. On their rooftops and in their squares, everyone wails, melting in tears.

verses.kjv: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.
verses.modern: Heshbon and Elealeh cry out; their voices are heard as far as Jahaz. Therefore the warriors of Moab cry out; his soul trembles within him.

verses.kjv: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.
verses.modern: My heart cries out for Moab. His fugitives flee to Zoar, to Eglath-shelishiyah. For at the ascent of Luhith they go up weeping; on the road to Horonaim they raise a cry of destruction.

verses.kjv: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
verses.modern: For the waters of Nimrim are desolate; the grass is withered, the vegetation fails, there is nothing green.

verses.kjv: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.
verses.modern: Therefore the abundance they have gained and what they have stored up they carry away over the Brook of the Willows.

verses.kjv: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beerelim.
verses.modern: The cry has gone around the borders of Moab. Its wailing reaches to Eglaim; its wailing reaches to Beer-elim.

verses.kjv: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.
verses.modern: For the waters of Dibon are full of blood; yet I will bring even more on Dibon — a lion for those of Moab who escape, and for the remnant of the land.

chapters.summary: Isaiah pronounces the burden against Moab. In one night Ar of Moab is laid waste and Kir of Moab is destroyed. The people flee, weeping as they go, and the waters of Nimrim are desolate.

verses.kjv: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
verses.modern: Send the tribute lamb to the ruler of the land — from Sela, through the wilderness, to the mount of the daughter of Zion.

verses.kjv: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
verses.modern: Like fluttering birds pushed from the nest, so are the daughters of Moab at the fords of the Arnon.

verses.kjv: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
verses.modern: "Give counsel; grant justice. Make your shadow like night at noon. Hide the outcasts; do not betray the fugitive.

verses.kjv: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
verses.modern: Let the outcasts of Moab stay with you; be a shelter to them from the destroyer. When the oppressor is no more and destruction has ceased and the enemy has gone from the land,

verses.kjv: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
verses.modern: then a throne shall be established in mercy, and on it shall sit in faithfulness, in the tent of David, one who judges and seeks justice and is swift to do righteousness."

verses.kjv: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
verses.modern: We have heard of the pride of Moab — how proud he is — of his arrogance, his pride, and his insolence. His boasts are empty.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kirhareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.
verses.modern: Therefore Moab wails for Moab — everyone wails. For the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth you shall mourn — utterly stricken.

verses.kjv: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
verses.modern: For the fields of Heshbon wither, the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have struck down its choice branches, which reached to Jazer and wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots spread out and crossed over the sea.

verses.kjv: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.
verses.modern: Therefore I weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I drench you with my tears, O Heshbon and Elealeh, for over your summer fruit and your harvest the shout has fallen away.

verses.kjv: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
verses.modern: Gladness and joy are taken away from the fruitful field. In the vineyards there is no singing and no shouting. No one treads out wine in the presses; I have put an end to the harvest shout.

verses.kjv: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kirharesh.
verses.modern: Therefore my heart moans for Moab like a harp, and my inmost being for Kir-hareseth.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
verses.modern: When Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, when he comes to his sanctuary to pray, he shall not prevail.

verses.kjv: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
verses.modern: This is the word the LORD spoke concerning Moab in the past.

verses.kjv: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
verses.modern: But now the LORD has spoken: "Within three years, like the years of a hired worker, the glory of Moab will be brought into contempt — despite all His great crowd. What remains will be very small and weak."

chapters.summary: Isaiah continues the burden against Moab. The Moabites are counseled to send tribute to Zion, and a throne will be established in mercy in the tent of David. Moab howls for her destroyed fields and vineyards, and within three years her glory will be brought low.

verses.kjv: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
verses.modern: The burden of Damascus. Damascus will cease to be a city; it will become a heap of ruins.

verses.kjv: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.modern: The cities of Aroer are abandoned — left for flocks that shall lie down with no one to disturb them.

verses.kjv: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: The fortress shall disappear from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus. The remnant of Syria shall be like the fading glory of the children of Israel, declares the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
verses.modern: In that day the glory of Jacob shall fade, and the fat of his body shall grow lean.

verses.kjv: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.modern: It shall be as when a reaper gathers standing grain and his arm harvests the ears — as when one gleans ears of grain in the Valley of Rephaim.

verses.kjv: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the LORD God of Israel.
verses.modern: Yet gleanings shall be left in it, as when an olive tree is beaten — two or three berries in the top of the highest branch, four or five on the branches of a fruitful tree, declares the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.modern: In that day men shall look to their Maker, and their eyes shall regard the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.
verses.modern: They shall not look to the altars — the work of their hands — nor shall they regard what their fingers have made, either the groves or the images.

verses.kjv: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
verses.modern: In that day their strong cities shall be like abandoned places in the forest, like the deserted summits that the Israelites abandoned — there shall be desolation.

verses.kjv: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:
verses.modern: For You have forgotten the God of Your salvation and have not remembered the Rock of Your strength. Therefore, though You plant pleasant gardens and set out slips of a foreign vine,

verses.kjv: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
verses.modern: though You make them grow on the day You plant them and make them blossom on the morning You sow, the harvest shall flee away on a day of grief and desperate sorrow.

verses.kjv: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
verses.modern: Woe to the roar of many peoples — they roar like the roaring of the seas! Woe to the surging of nations — they surge like the surging of mighty waters!

verses.kjv: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
verses.modern: The nations rush like the rushing of many waters, but He will rebuke them and they shall flee far away — chased like chaff on the mountains before the wind and like dust before the storm.

verses.kjv: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
verses.modern: At evening time — terror! Before morning — they are gone! This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the fate of those who rob us.

chapters.summary: Isaiah pronounces the burden against Damascus. Damascus will cease to be a city and become a ruinous heap. Israel's glory will also grow thin. In that day a man will look to his Maker rather than to altars made by his own hands.

verses.kjv: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
verses.modern: Woe to the land of whirring wings, which is beyond the rivers of Cush,

verses.kjv: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!
verses.modern: which sends ambassadors by sea, in vessels of papyrus on the waters! Go, swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth-skinned — to a people feared near and far — a nation mighty and trampling, whose land the rivers divide.

verses.kjv: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.
verses.modern: All You inhabitants of the world and dwellers on the earth — when an ensign is raised on the mountains, look! When a trumpet is blown, hear!

verses.kjv: For so the LORD said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
verses.modern: For the LORD said to me, "I will quietly look from My dwelling like shimmering heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest."

verses.kjv: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.
verses.modern: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over and the flower becomes a ripening grape, He will cut off the shoots with pruning hooks, and the spreading branches He will cut away.

verses.kjv: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
verses.modern: They shall all be left to the birds of the mountains and the beasts of the earth. The birds of prey shall summer on them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter on them.

verses.kjv: In that time shall the present be brought unto the LORD of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion.
verses.modern: At that time a gift shall be brought to the LORD of hosts from a people tall and smooth-skinned — from a people feared near and far, a nation mighty and conquering, whose land the rivers divide — to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, to Mount Zion.

chapters.summary: Isaiah prophesies woe to the land beyond the rivers of Ethiopia that sends ambassadors by sea. The LORD will watch quietly as the Assyrian threat ripens, then cut it down. Afterward gifts will be brought to the LORD of hosts from a people tall and smooth-skinned.

verses.kjv: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
verses.modern: The burden of Egypt. The LORD is riding on a swift cloud and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt tremble before Him, and the heart of Egypt melts within it.

verses.kjv: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
verses.modern: I will stir up Egyptians against Egyptians, and they shall fight — each against His brother and each against His neighbor — city against city, kingdom against kingdom.

verses.kjv: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
verses.modern: The spirit of Egypt shall fail within it, and I will confuse their counsel. They shall seek guidance from the idols, from the charmers, and from those who have familiar spirits, and from the wizards.

verses.kjv: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a harsh master, and a fierce king shall rule over them, declares the Lord, the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
verses.modern: The waters of the Nile shall be dried up; the river shall be parched and dry.

verses.kjv: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
verses.modern: Its canals shall stink; the streams of Egypt shall dry up. The reeds and rushes shall wither.

verses.kjv: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
verses.modern: The plants along the Nile, at the mouth of the Nile, and everything sown by the Nile shall dry up and blow away and be no more.

verses.kjv: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
verses.modern: The fishermen shall mourn; all who cast hooks into the Nile shall grieve; those who spread nets on the water shall waste away.

verses.kjv: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
verses.modern: Those who work with combed flax and those who weave white cloth shall be put to shame.

verses.kjv: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.
verses.modern: The weavers of Egypt shall be crushed; all who make wages shall be grieved.

verses.kjv: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
verses.modern: The princes of Zoan are complete fools; the wise counselors of Pharaoh give stupid advice. How can you say to Pharaoh, "I am a son of the wise, a son of ancient kings"?

verses.kjv: Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.
verses.modern: Where then are Your wise men? Let them tell You and make known what the LORD of hosts has purposed against Egypt.

verses.kjv: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
verses.modern: The princes of Zoan have become fools; the princes of Memphis are deluded. Those who are the cornerstone of her tribes have led Egypt astray.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.
verses.modern: The LORD has mixed into her a spirit of confusion, and they have made Egypt stagger in all its deeds, as a drunkard staggers in His vomit.

verses.kjv: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
verses.modern: There shall be nothing for Egypt to do — neither head nor tail, palm branch nor reed.

verses.kjv: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.
verses.modern: In that day the Egyptians shall be like women — trembling with fear because of the hand that the LORD of hosts shakes over them.

verses.kjv: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
verses.modern: The land of Judah shall become a terror to Egypt. Whenever anyone mentions it, Egypt shall dread it because of the purpose the LORD of hosts has purposed against it.

verses.kjv: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.
verses.modern: In that day there shall be five cities in Egypt that speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the LORD of hosts. One shall be called the City of Destruction.

verses.kjv: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.
verses.modern: In that day there shall be an altar to the LORD in the midst of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD at its border.

verses.kjv: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
verses.modern: It shall be a sign and a witness to the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt. When they cry to the LORD because of oppressors, He will send them a savior and defender, and He will deliver them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD, and perform it.
verses.modern: The LORD will make Himself known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the LORD in that day. They will worship with sacrifice and offering, and they will make vows to the LORD and keep them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the LORD, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
verses.modern: The LORD will strike Egypt, striking but healing. They shall turn to the LORD, and He will respond to their pleas and heal them.

verses.kjv: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
verses.modern: In that day there shall be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall worship with the Assyrians.

verses.kjv: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:
verses.modern: In that day Israel shall be the third with Egypt and with Assyria — a blessing in the midst of the earth,

verses.kjv: Whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.
verses.modern: whom the LORD of hosts has blessed, saying, "Blessed be Egypt My people, Assyria the work of My hands, and Israel My inheritance."

chapters.summary: Isaiah pronounces the burden against Egypt. The LORD rides on a swift cloud into Egypt, and the idols tremble. Egypt will be given over to a fierce king, the Nile will dry up, and the wise counselors of Pharaoh will become fools. In that day Egypt and Assyria will worship the LORD together with Israel, and Egypt will be called the LORD's people.

verses.kjv: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
verses.modern: In the year that the Tartan came to Ashdod — when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him — he fought against Ashdod and captured it.

verses.kjv: At the same time spake the LORD by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
verses.modern: At that time the LORD spoke through Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, "Go, remove the sackcloth from Your waist and take off Your sandals from Your feet." He did so, walking naked and barefoot.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
verses.modern: The LORD said, "Just as My servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot for three years as a sign and a wonder against Egypt and Cush,

verses.kjv: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
verses.modern: so shall the king of Assyria lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Cush, young and old, naked and barefoot, with their buttocks uncovered — the shame of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
verses.modern: They shall be terrified and put to shame because of Cush their hope and of Egypt their boast.

verses.kjv: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
verses.modern: The inhabitants of this coastland shall say in that day, 'Such is our hope — those to whom we fled for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria! How shall we escape?' "

chapters.summary: The LORD commands Isaiah to walk naked and barefoot for three years as a sign that the king of Assyria will lead away Egyptian and Ethiopian captives, young and old, naked and barefoot. Those who trusted in Ethiopia and Egypt for deliverance will be ashamed.

verses.kjv: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
verses.modern: The burden of the Desert of the Sea. Like whirlwinds sweeping through the south, it comes from the desert, from a fearful land.

verses.kjv: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
verses.modern: A harsh vision has been shown to me. The traitor betrays, the destroyer destroys. "Go up, O Elam! Besiege, O Media!" I have put an end to all the groaning.

verses.kjv: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
verses.modern: Therefore my whole body is filled with anguish; pains have seized me like the pains of a woman in labor. I am too troubled to hear; I am too dismayed to see.

verses.kjv: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.
verses.modern: My heart reels; horror has overwhelmed me. The twilight I longed for has become dread for me.

verses.kjv: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.
verses.modern: Prepare the table; set the watch; eat and drink. Arise, O princes! Oil the shield!

verses.kjv: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
verses.modern: For thus the Lord said to me: "Go, post a watchman; let him announce what he sees."

verses.kjv: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
verses.modern: When he sees riders — horsemen in pairs, riders on donkeys, riders on camels — let him listen carefully, very carefully.

verses.kjv: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
verses.modern: Then the watchman called out: "O Lord, I stand on the watchtower all day long; I have been stationed at my post every night.

verses.kjv: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
verses.modern: And a troop of men is coming, horsemen in pairs!" He answered, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon! All the carved images of her gods are shattered to the ground."

verses.kjv: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
verses.modern: O my threshed and winnowed one, what I have heard from the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, I now declare to You.

verses.kjv: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
verses.modern: The burden of Dumah. Someone is calling to me from Seir: "Watchman, how much of the night is left? Watchman, how much of the night is left?"

verses.kjv: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
verses.modern: The watchman says, "Morning comes, and also night. If You will inquire, come back and inquire."

verses.kjv: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
verses.modern: The burden against Arabia. In the thickets of Arabia You shall lodge, O caravans of Dedanites.

verses.kjv: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
verses.modern: Bring water for the thirsty; the inhabitants of the land of Tema meet the fugitive with bread.

verses.kjv: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
verses.modern: For they have fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the fierce battle.

verses.kjv: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
verses.modern: For thus the Lord has said to me: "Within a year, like the years of a hired worker, all the glory of Kedar shall come to an end.

verses.kjv: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken it.
verses.modern: The surviving archers of Kedar's warriors shall be few, for the LORD God of Israel has spoken."

chapters.summary: Isaiah pronounces the burden of the desert of the sea -- Babylon is fallen, is fallen, and all the graven images of her gods are broken to the ground. He also pronounces burdens against Dumah and Arabia, declaring that within a year the glory of Kedar will fail.

verses.kjv: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
verses.modern: The burden of the Valley of Vision. What is wrong with You now, that You have all gone up to the rooftops?

verses.kjv: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
verses.modern: You who were full of commotion, a riotous and joyful city — your slain were not slain with the sword, nor did they die in battle.

verses.kjv: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.
verses.modern: All Your rulers fled together; they were captured without the bow. All of You who were found were captured, though You had fled far away.

verses.kjv: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
verses.modern: Therefore I said, "Look away from me; let me weep bitterly. Do not labor to comfort me over the destruction of the daughter of my people."

verses.kjv: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord GOD of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
verses.modern: For the Lord GOD of hosts has a day of panic, of trampling, and of confusion in the Valley of Vision — a day of breaking down walls and of crying to the mountains.

verses.kjv: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.modern: Elam bore the quiver, with chariots and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
verses.modern: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen were positioned at the gate.

verses.kjv: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
verses.modern: He stripped away the covering of Judah. In that day You looked to the weapons in the House of the Forest.

verses.kjv: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
verses.modern: You saw the breaches of the city of David, that they were many. You collected the waters of the lower pool.

verses.kjv: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
verses.modern: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you tore down houses to strengthen the wall.

verses.kjv: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
verses.modern: You made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool — but you did not look to Him who made it, nor regard Him who planned it long ago.

verses.kjv: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
verses.modern: In that day the Lord GOD of hosts called for weeping and mourning, for shaving the head and putting on sackcloth.

verses.kjv: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
verses.modern: Instead, there was joy and gladness, killing oxen, slaughtering sheep, eating meat, and drinking wine. "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!"

verses.kjv: And it was revealed in mine ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
verses.modern: The LORD of hosts revealed Himself in my hearing: "This iniquity will not be forgiven You until You die," says the Lord GOD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,
verses.modern: Thus says the Lord GOD of hosts: "Go to this steward, to Shebna who is in charge of the household, and say to Him,

verses.kjv: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?
verses.modern: 'What have You here, and whom have You here, that You have cut out a tomb for Yourself here — cutting out a tomb on the height and carving a dwelling for Yourself in the rock?

verses.kjv: Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.
verses.modern: The LORD is about to hurl You away, mighty man! He will seize You firmly

verses.kjv: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy master's house.
verses.modern: and roll You up tightly like a ball and throw You into a wide land. There You shall die, and there Your glorious chariots shall be — a disgrace to Your master's house.'

verses.kjv: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
verses.modern: I will thrust You from Your office, and You will be pulled down from Your post.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
verses.modern: In that day I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,

verses.kjv: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verses.modern: I will clothe Him with Your robe and strengthen Him with Your belt. I will commit Your authority into His hand. He shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.

verses.kjv: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
verses.modern: I will place on his shoulder the key of the house of David. What he opens, no one can shut; and what he shuts, no one can open.

verses.kjv: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.
verses.modern: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place. He will become a throne of glory to his father's house.

verses.kjv: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
verses.modern: They shall hang on him the whole honor of his father's house — offspring and offspring's children, every small vessel, from bowls to all the jars.

verses.kjv: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.modern: In that day, declares the LORD of hosts, the peg that was driven into the firm place will give way. It will be cut down and fall, and the load hanging on it will be cut off. The LORD has spoken.

chapters.summary: Isaiah pronounces the burden of the valley of vision -- Jerusalem. The people prepare their defenses but do not look to the God who made them. The LORD calls for weeping and mourning, but they feast instead, saying, 'Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.' Shebna the steward is removed from office and replaced by Eliakim.

verses.kjv: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
verses.modern: The burden of Tyre. Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for Tyre is laid waste — without house or harbor! From the land of Cyprus this has been revealed to them.

verses.kjv: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
verses.modern: Be silent, O inhabitants of the coastland, You whom the merchants of Sidon crossing the sea have enriched.

verses.kjv: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
verses.modern: Over many waters came the grain of the Nile — the harvest of the River — and she was the marketplace of nations.

verses.kjv: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.
verses.modern: Be ashamed, O Sidon, for the sea has spoken — the stronghold of the sea says, "I have neither labored nor given birth; I have not raised young men nor brought up young women."

verses.kjv: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
verses.modern: When the report reaches Egypt, they shall be in anguish over the report about Tyre.

verses.kjv: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
verses.modern: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, O inhabitants of the coastland!

verses.kjv: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
verses.modern: Is this Your joyful city, whose origin is from ancient days? Her feet shall carry her far away to stay in a distant land.

verses.kjv: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?
verses.modern: Who has planned this against Tyre, the city that bestowed crowns, whose merchants were princes, whose traders were among the honored of the earth?

verses.kjv: The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
verses.modern: The LORD of hosts has purposed it — to defile the pride of all glory, to dishonor all the honored of the earth.

verses.kjv: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
verses.modern: Cross Your land like the Nile, O daughter of Tarshish — there is no restraint anymore.

verses.kjv: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
verses.modern: He has stretched His hand over the sea; He has shaken the kingdoms. The LORD has given command concerning Canaan to destroy her strongholds.

verses.kjv: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
verses.modern: He said, "You shall no longer exult, O oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Rise and cross over to Cyprus — even there You shall find no rest."

verses.kjv: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
verses.modern: Look at the land of the Chaldeans — this people who were nothing! Assyria founded it for desert dwellers. They set up their siege towers, they stripped bare Tyre's palaces, and made it a ruin.

verses.kjv: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
verses.modern: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for Your stronghold is laid waste!

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
verses.modern: In that day Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years — the length of one king's life. At the end of seventy years, Tyre shall sing like a harlot.

verses.kjv: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
verses.modern: "Take a harp; go around the city, O forgotten harlot! Play sweetly, sing many songs, so that You may be remembered."

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
verses.modern: At the end of seventy years, the LORD will visit Tyre. She shall return to her wages and prostitute herself with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

verses.kjv: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
verses.modern: Her profits and her wages shall be holy to the LORD. They shall not be stored or hoarded, but her gains shall go to those who live before the LORD — to eat their fill and wear fine clothing.

chapters.summary: Isaiah pronounces the burden against Tyre. The merchant city of the sea will be laid waste, her merchants who were princes will be dishonored, and for seventy years Tyre will be forgotten. After seventy years the LORD will visit Tyre and her merchandise shall be devoted to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
verses.modern: The LORD is making the earth empty and laying it waste. He is twisting its surface and scattering its inhabitants.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
verses.modern: The same fate shall come on the people and the priest, the servant and his master, the maid and her mistress, the buyer and the seller, the lender and the borrower, the creditor and the debtor.

verses.kjv: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.
verses.modern: The earth shall be utterly emptied and utterly plundered, for the LORD has spoken this word.

verses.kjv: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
verses.modern: The earth mourns and withers; the world fades and withers; the highest people of the earth fade away.

verses.kjv: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.modern: The earth is defiled by its inhabitants, for they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

verses.kjv: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
verses.modern: Therefore a curse devours the earth; its inhabitants suffer for their guilt. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are scorched, and few men are left.

verses.kjv: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
verses.modern: The wine mourns; the vine fades. All the merry-hearted sigh.

verses.kjv: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
verses.modern: The joyful tambourines are stilled; the noise of the jubilant has ceased; the joyful harp is silent.

verses.kjv: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
verses.modern: No longer do they drink wine with singing. Strong drink is bitter to those who drink it.

verses.kjv: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
verses.modern: The city of chaos is broken down; every house is locked up so no one can enter.

verses.kjv: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
verses.modern: There is an outcry in the streets for lack of wine; all joy has turned to gloom; the gladness of the earth is banished.

verses.kjv: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
verses.modern: Desolation is left in the city; the gate is battered to ruins.

verses.kjv: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
verses.modern: For so it shall be in the midst of the earth among the nations — as when an olive tree is beaten, as at the gleaning when the grape harvest is done.

verses.kjv: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
verses.modern: They lift up their voices; they sing for joy. Over the majesty of the LORD they shout from the west.

verses.kjv: Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires, even the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea.
verses.modern: Therefore in the east give glory to the LORD; in the coastlands of the sea, give glory to the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
verses.modern: From the ends of the earth we hear songs of praise — "Glory to the Righteous One!" But I say, "I am wasting away; I am wasting away! Woe to me! The treacherous deal treacherously; the treacherous deal very treacherously."

verses.kjv: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.
verses.modern: Terror, pit, and snare are upon You, O inhabitant of the earth!

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
verses.modern: Whoever flees at the sound of terror shall fall into the pit, and whoever climbs out of the pit shall be caught in the snare. For the windows from on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

verses.kjv: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
verses.modern: The earth is violently broken; the earth is split apart; the earth is shaken violently.

verses.kjv: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
verses.modern: The earth staggers like a drunkard; it sways like a hut. Its transgression lies heavy upon it; it falls and will not rise again.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
verses.modern: In that day the LORD will punish the host of heaven in heaven, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

verses.kjv: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
verses.modern: They shall be gathered together as prisoners are gathered in a pit. They shall be shut up in a prison, and after many days they shall be punished.

verses.kjv: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.
verses.modern: The moon shall be put to shame and the sun ashamed, for the LORD of hosts reigns on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and His glory is before His elders.

chapters.summary: The LORD will lay waste the whole earth, making it empty and turning it upside down. The earth mourns and the merry-hearted sigh. The earth is utterly broken down. The LORD of hosts shall reign in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before His elders He will be glorified.

verses.kjv: O LORD, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
verses.modern: O LORD, You are my God. I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have done wonderful things — plans formed long ago, faithful and sure.

verses.kjv: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
verses.modern: For You have made a city a heap of rubble, a fortified city a ruin — a palace of foreigners to be a city no more. It shall never be rebuilt.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.
verses.modern: Therefore strong peoples will glorify You; cities of ruthless nations shall fear You.

verses.kjv: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
verses.modern: For You have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in His distress, a shelter from the storm and a shade from the heat. When the blast of the ruthless was like a storm against a wall,

verses.kjv: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
verses.modern: You subdued the noise of foreigners — like heat in a dry place — with the shadow of a cloud. The song of the ruthless was silenced.

verses.kjv: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
verses.modern: On this mountain the LORD of hosts will prepare for all peoples a feast of rich food — a feast of aged wine, of rich food full of marrow, of aged wine well refined.

verses.kjv: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.
verses.modern: He will swallow up on this mountain the covering that is cast over all peoples, the veil that is spread over all nations.

verses.kjv: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.modern: He will swallow up death in victory. The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from all faces, and the reproach of His people He will take away from all the earth. The LORD has spoken.

verses.kjv: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
verses.modern: It shall be said in that day, "This is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the LORD; we have waited for Him. Let us be glad and rejoice in His salvation."

verses.kjv: For in this mountain shall the hand of the LORD rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.
verses.modern: For the hand of the LORD shall rest on this mountain, and Moab shall be trampled down in His place — as straw is trampled down in a manure pile.

verses.kjv: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
verses.modern: He shall spread out His hands in the midst of it, as a swimmer spreads His hands to swim. His pride shall be laid low together with the skill of His hands.

verses.kjv: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.
verses.modern: The high fortifications of Your walls He will bring down, lay low, and cast to the ground — to the dust.

chapters.summary: Isaiah praises the LORD for His wonderful works and faithful counsels. The LORD will make a feast of rich food for all peoples on this mountain and will swallow up death forever. He will wipe away tears from all faces and remove the disgrace of His people.

verses.kjv: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
verses.modern: In that day this song shall be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city. God appoints salvation as walls and ramparts.

verses.kjv: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
verses.modern: Open the gates, so the righteous nation that keeps faith may enter in.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
verses.modern: You keep Him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on You, because He trusts in You.

verses.kjv: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:
verses.modern: Trust in the LORD forever, for the LORD JEHOVAH is an everlasting rock.

verses.kjv: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.
verses.modern: For He brings down those who dwell on high; He lays the lofty city low — lays it low to the ground, casts it to the dust.

verses.kjv: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
verses.modern: The foot shall trample it — the feet of the poor and the steps of the humble.

verses.kjv: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
verses.modern: The path of the righteous is level. You, who are upright, make the way of the righteous smooth.

verses.kjv: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
verses.modern: In the path of Your judgments, O LORD, we wait for You. Your name and Your remembrance are the desire of our soul.

verses.kjv: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
verses.modern: My soul yearns for You in the night; my spirit within me earnestly seeks You. For when Your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

verses.kjv: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
verses.modern: If favor is shown to the wicked, he does not learn righteousness. Even in the land of uprightness He deals corruptly and does not see the majesty of the LORD.

verses.kjv: LORD, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
verses.modern: O LORD, Your hand is lifted up, but they do not see it. Let them see Your zeal for Your people and be ashamed. Let fire for Your adversaries consume them.

verses.kjv: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
verses.modern: O LORD, You will ordain peace for us, for You have also done all our works for us.

verses.kjv: O LORD our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
verses.modern: O LORD our God, other lords besides You have ruled over us, but we acknowledge Your name alone.

verses.kjv: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
verses.modern: The dead do not live; departed spirits do not rise. You have punished them and destroyed them; You have wiped out all memory of them.

verses.kjv: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.
verses.modern: You have increased the nation, O LORD; You have increased the nation. You are glorified. You have extended all the borders of the land.

verses.kjv: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.
verses.modern: O LORD, in distress they sought You; they poured out a whispered prayer when Your discipline was on them.

verses.kjv: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.
verses.modern: Like a pregnant woman who writhes and cries out in her pangs when she is near to giving birth, so were we before You, O LORD.

verses.kjv: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.modern: We were pregnant; we writhed — but we gave birth to wind. We have accomplished no deliverance in the earth, and the inhabitants of the world have not fallen.

verses.kjv: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
verses.modern: Your dead shall live; their bodies shall rise. You who dwell in the dust, awake and sing for joy! For Your dew is a dew of light, and the earth will give birth to the dead.

verses.kjv: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
verses.modern: Come, my people, enter Your rooms and shut Your doors behind You. Hide for a little while until the fury has passed by.

verses.kjv: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
verses.modern: For the LORD is coming out of His place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth will disclose the blood shed on her; she will no longer cover her slain.

chapters.summary: Isaiah sings a song of the strong city -- salvation is appointed for walls and bulwarks. The righteous nation that keeps the truth shall enter in. The LORD is the everlasting rock who brings down the lofty city. Isaiah longs for the LORD in the night and declares that the dead shall live and the earth shall cast out the dead.

verses.kjv: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.
verses.modern: In that day the LORD with His hard and great and strong sword will punish Leviathan the fleeing serpent — Leviathan the twisting serpent — and He will slay the dragon that is in the sea.

verses.kjv: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
verses.modern: In that day, "A pleasant vineyard — sing of it!

verses.kjv: I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
verses.modern: I, the LORD, am its keeper; every moment I water it. Lest anyone harm it, I keep it night and day.

verses.kjv: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
verses.modern: I have no fury. If briers and thorns confront Me in battle, I will march against them and burn them up together.

verses.kjv: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.
verses.modern: Or let them take hold of My protection; let them make peace with Me — let them make peace with Me."

verses.kjv: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
verses.modern: In days to come Jacob shall take root; Israel shall blossom and put forth shoots and fill the whole world with fruit.

verses.kjv: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
verses.modern: Has He struck them as He struck those who struck them? Or have they been slain as their slayers were slain?

verses.kjv: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
verses.modern: Measure by measure, by exile, You contended with them. He removed them with His fierce wind on the day of the east wind.

verses.kjv: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.
verses.modern: By this the iniquity of Jacob shall be forgiven — this is the full fruit of removing his sin — when he makes all the altar stones like crushed chalk, so that the groves and images shall not stand up.
