verses.kjv: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
verses.modern: For the fortified city is alone, a deserted settlement, abandoned like a wilderness. Calves graze there; there they lie down and strip its branches.

verses.kjv: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
verses.modern: When its branches wither, they are broken off; women come and make a fire with them. For this is a people without understanding; therefore He who made them will not have mercy on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
verses.modern: In that day the LORD will thresh from the channel of the Euphrates to the Brook of Egypt, and You will be gathered one by one, O people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
verses.modern: In that day a great trumpet shall be blown, and those who were perishing in Assyria and those who were driven out to Egypt shall come and worship the LORD on the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

chapters.summary: In that day the LORD will punish leviathan the fleeing serpent with His great sword. He will keep His vineyard, watering it every moment. Jacob's iniquity will be purged when the altar stones are crushed, and in that day a great trumpet will sound and the outcasts of Israel will worship the LORD in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!
verses.modern: Woe to the proud crown of Ephraim's drunkards, and to the fading flower of their glorious beauty — set on the head of the rich valley of those overcome with wine!

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.
verses.modern: The Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying tempest — like a flood of mighty waters overflowing — He casts down to the earth with violence.

verses.kjv: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:
verses.modern: The proud crown of Ephraim's drunkards shall be trampled underfoot.

verses.kjv: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.
verses.modern: The fading flower of their glorious beauty set on the head of the rich valley shall be like a first-ripe fig before the summer. Whoever sees it swallows it as soon as it is in his hand.

verses.kjv: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,
verses.modern: In that day the LORD of hosts shall be a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the remnant of His people,

verses.kjv: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.
verses.modern: a spirit of justice to Him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

verses.kjv: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.
verses.modern: These also reel with wine and stagger with strong drink — priest and prophet reel with strong drink; they are overcome by wine. They stagger when seeing visions; they stumble when giving judgment.

verses.kjv: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.
verses.modern: All their tables are covered with vomit; not a spot is clean.

verses.kjv: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.
verses.modern: "To whom will He teach knowledge, and to whom will He explain the message? Those just weaned from milk, those just taken from the breast?

verses.kjv: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:
verses.modern: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little."

verses.kjv: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.
verses.modern: For by people of strange lips and with a foreign tongue the LORD will speak to this people,

verses.kjv: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
verses.modern: to whom He had said, "This is rest; give rest to the weary. This is refreshing." But they would not hear.

verses.kjv: But the word of the LORD was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
verses.modern: The word of the LORD shall be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little — so that they may go, stumble backward, be broken, snared, and taken.

verses.kjv: Wherefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Therefore, hear the word of the LORD, You scoffers, who rule this people in Jerusalem!

verses.kjv: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:
verses.modern: Because You have said, "We have made a covenant with death, and with hell we are in agreement. When the overwhelming scourge passes through, it will not come to us, for we have made lies our refuge, and in falsehood we have taken shelter,"

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
verses.modern: therefore thus says the Lord GOD: "I am laying in Zion a stone — a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation. Whoever believes will not be in a hurry.

verses.kjv: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.
verses.modern: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the plumb line. Hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and waters shall overflow the hiding place.

verses.kjv: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.
verses.modern: Your covenant with death will be annulled, and Your agreement with hell shall not stand. When the overwhelming scourge passes through, You will be beaten down by it.

verses.kjv: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.
verses.modern: As often as it passes through, it shall take You — morning by morning, by day and by night — and it shall be sheer terror to understand the message.

verses.kjv: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.
verses.modern: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the cover too narrow to wrap oneself in.

verses.kjv: For the LORD shall rise up as in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.
verses.modern: For the LORD will rise up as on Mount Perazim; He will be roused as in the Valley of Gibeon. He will do His work — His strange work — and perform His task — His alien task.

verses.kjv: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.
verses.modern: Now therefore do not mock, lest Your bonds be made strong. For I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord GOD of hosts against the whole earth.

verses.kjv: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
verses.modern: Give ear and hear my voice; listen and hear my speech.

verses.kjv: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?
verses.modern: Does the farmer plow all day just to plant? Does He keep opening and breaking up the soil?

verses.kjv: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?
verses.modern: When He has leveled its surface, does He not scatter dill and sow cumin, plant wheat in rows and barley in its proper place, and spelt as its border?

verses.kjv: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth teach him.
verses.modern: His God instructs Him and teaches Him the right way.

verses.kjv: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.
verses.modern: Dill is not threshed with a threshing sledge, nor is a cart wheel rolled over cumin. But dill is beaten with a stick and cumin with a rod.

verses.kjv: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.
verses.modern: Grain must be crushed. One does not thresh it forever. A cart wheel and horses may be driven over it, but it is not crushed.

verses.kjv: This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.
verses.modern: This also comes from the LORD of hosts. He is wonderful in counsel and great in wisdom.

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounces woe to the drunkards of Ephraim whose glorious beauty is a fading flower. He will lay in Zion a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation. He rebukes the scornful rulers of Jerusalem who have made a covenant with death, declaring that their agreement with hell shall not stand.

verses.kjv: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.
verses.modern: Woe to Ariel — Ariel, the city where David camped! Add year to year; let the feasts run their cycle.

verses.kjv: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
verses.modern: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to Me like an altar hearth.

verses.kjv: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.
verses.modern: I will encamp against you all around; I will besiege you with towers and raise siegeworks against you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.
verses.modern: Brought down, you shall speak from the ground; your words shall come from the dust. Your voice shall be like a ghost's from the ground; from the dust your speech shall whisper.

verses.kjv: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
verses.modern: But the crowd of your foes shall be like fine dust, and the crowd of the ruthless like passing chaff. It shall happen suddenly, in an instant.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt be visited of the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
verses.modern: You shall be visited by the LORD of hosts with thunder, earthquake, and great noise — with whirlwind, tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.

verses.kjv: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
verses.modern: The crowd of all the nations that fight against Ariel — all who fight against her and her stronghold and distress her — shall be like a dream, a vision of the night.

verses.kjv: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
verses.modern: It shall be like a hungry man who dreams He is eating — then wakes, and is still hungry — or like a thirsty man who dreams He is drinking — then wakes, and is still faint with thirst. So shall the crowd of all the nations be that fight against Mount Zion.

verses.kjv: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
verses.modern: Pause and wonder — blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunk, but not with wine; they stagger, but not from strong drink.

verses.kjv: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.
verses.modern: For the LORD has poured out on You a spirit of deep sleep. He has closed Your eyes — the prophets — and covered Your heads — the seers.

verses.kjv: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:
verses.modern: The vision of all this has become to You like the words of a sealed book. When people give it to one who can read and say, "Read this," he says, "I cannot, for it is sealed."

verses.kjv: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.
verses.modern: When they give it to one who cannot read and say, "Read this," he says, "I cannot read."

verses.kjv: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
verses.modern: The Lord said: "Because this people draw near to Me with their mouth and honor Me with their lips, while their hearts are far from Me, and their fear of Me is a commandment taught by men,

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.
verses.modern: therefore I will again do a marvelous work among this people — a marvelous work and a wonder. The wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their discerning men shall be hidden."

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
verses.modern: Woe to those who go to great depths to hide their plans from the LORD, Who do their deeds in the dark and say, "Who sees us? Who knows us?"

verses.kjv: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
verses.modern: You turn things upside down! Shall the potter be regarded as the clay — that the thing made should say of its maker, "He did not make me," or the thing formed say of Him who formed it, "He has no understanding"?

verses.kjv: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
verses.modern: Is it not yet a very little while until Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be regarded as a forest?

verses.kjv: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
verses.modern: In that day the deaf shall hear the words of a book, and out of their gloom and darkness the eyes of the blind shall see.

verses.kjv: The meek also shall increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.modern: The humble shall obtain fresh joy in the LORD, and the poor among mankind shall exult in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
verses.modern: For the ruthless shall come to nothing and the scoffer shall cease; and all who watch for evil shall be cut off —

verses.kjv: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
verses.modern: those who make a man out to be a criminal by a word, who lay a snare for the one who argues justly at the gate, and who push aside the innocent with empty arguments.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
verses.modern: Therefore thus says the LORD, Who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: "Jacob shall no longer be ashamed; no longer shall his face grow pale.

verses.kjv: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.
verses.modern: For when He sees His children — the work of My hands — in His midst, they shall sanctify My name. They shall sanctify the Holy One of Jacob and stand in awe of the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
verses.modern: Those who go astray in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will accept instruction."

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounces woe to Ariel -- Jerusalem -- which He will besiege and bring low, yet the multitude of her enemies will be like a dream that vanishes. He rebukes those who seek to hide their plans from the LORD and those whose worship is mere lip service while their hearts are far from Him. Lebanon shall become a fruitful field and the deaf shall hear and the blind shall see.

verses.kjv: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:
verses.modern: "Woe to the rebellious children," says the LORD, "who carry out plans that are not Mine, who make alliances, but not in My Spirit — adding sin to sin.

verses.kjv: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
verses.modern: They go down to Egypt without asking Me, to take refuge in the protection of Pharaoh and seek shelter in the shadow of Egypt!

verses.kjv: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
verses.modern: The protection of Pharaoh shall become your shame, and the shelter in Egypt's shadow your disgrace.

verses.kjv: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.
verses.modern: For their princes are at Zoan and their envoys reach Hanes.

verses.kjv: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
verses.modern: Everyone shall be ashamed because of a people that cannot profit them — that brings neither help nor benefit, but only shame and disgrace."

verses.kjv: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.
verses.modern: The burden of the beasts of the south: through a land of trouble and anguish, of the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent — they carry their riches on the backs of young donkeys and their treasures on the humps of camels, to a people that cannot profit them.

verses.kjv: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.
verses.modern: Egypt's help is useless and empty; therefore I have called her "Rahab who sits still."

verses.kjv: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:
verses.modern: Now go, write it on a tablet before them; inscribe it in a book so it may be for the coming days, as a witness forever and ever.

verses.kjv: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the LORD:
verses.modern: For it is a rebellious people — lying children who will not hear the instruction of the LORD,

verses.kjv: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:
verses.modern: who say to the seers, "Do not see," and to the prophets, "Do not prophesy to us what is right. Tell us pleasing things; prophesy illusions.

verses.kjv: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.
verses.modern: Leave the way; turn aside from the path. Stop confronting us with the Holy One of Israel!"

verses.kjv: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:
verses.modern: Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel: "Because You reject this word and trust in oppression and deceit and rely on them,

verses.kjv: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.
verses.modern: this iniquity shall be to You like a breach in a high wall, bulging out and about to collapse — it breaks suddenly, in an instant.

verses.kjv: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.
verses.modern: It shall be broken like a potter's vessel that is smashed so ruthlessly that among its fragments no shard is found large enough to take fire from a hearth or scoop water from a cistern."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
verses.modern: For thus says the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel: "In returning and rest You shall be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be Your strength." But You were unwilling.

verses.kjv: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
verses.modern: You said, "No! We will flee on horses" — therefore You shall flee. "We will ride on swift horses" — therefore Your pursuers shall be swift.

verses.kjv: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.
verses.modern: A thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five You shall flee, until You are left like a flagstaff on the top of a mountain, like an ensign on a hill.

verses.kjv: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.
verses.modern: Therefore the LORD waits to be gracious to You; He rises to show You mercy. For the LORD is a God of judgment. Blessed are all those who wait for Him.

verses.kjv: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.
verses.modern: For a people shall dwell in Zion — in Jerusalem. You shall weep no more. He will surely be gracious to You at the sound of Your cry. When He hears it, He will answer You.

verses.kjv: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:
verses.modern: Though the Lord gives You the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, Your Teacher will no longer hide Himself. Your eyes shall see Your Teacher.

verses.kjv: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
verses.modern: Your ears shall hear a word behind You, saying, "This is the way, walk in it," when You turn to the right or when You turn to the left.

verses.kjv: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.
verses.modern: You shall defile Your carved idols overlaid with silver and Your gold-plated metal images. You shall scatter them like filthy rags. You shall say to them, "Be gone!"

verses.kjv: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.
verses.modern: He will give rain for the seed with which You sow the ground, and bread — the produce of the ground — will be rich and plentiful. In that day Your cattle will graze in broad pastures.

verses.kjv: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.
verses.modern: The oxen and the donkeys that work the ground will eat good fodder — winnowed with shovel and fork.

verses.kjv: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
verses.modern: On every high mountain and every high hill there shall be brooks running with water — in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

verses.kjv: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
verses.modern: The light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold — like the light of seven days — in the day when the LORD binds up the brokenness of His people and heals the wounds He inflicted.

verses.kjv: Behold, the name of the LORD cometh from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:
verses.modern: The name of the LORD comes from afar, burning with His anger, heavy with cloud. His lips are full of fury, and His tongue is like a devouring fire.

verses.kjv: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.
verses.modern: His breath is like an overflowing stream that reaches up to the neck — to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction, and to put a bridle on the jaws of the peoples that leads them astray.

verses.kjv: Ye shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel.
verses.modern: You shall have a song as in the night when a holy feast is kept, and gladness of heart as when one sets out to the sound of the flute to go to the mountain of the LORD, to the Rock of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.
verses.modern: The LORD will cause His majestic voice to be heard and show the descent of His arm — in furious anger — with consuming fire, with cloudburst, storm, and hailstones.

verses.kjv: For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.
verses.modern: For Assyria shall be terror-stricken at the voice of the LORD, when He strikes with His rod.

verses.kjv: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.
verses.modern: Every stroke of the appointed staff that the LORD lays on them shall be to the sound of tambourines and harps. Battling with brandished fist, He fights them.

verses.kjv: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.
verses.modern: For Topheth has long been prepared; it is made ready for the king. Its fire pit is made deep and wide, with plenty of fire and wood. The breath of the LORD, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.

chapters.summary: The LORD rebukes Judah for going down to Egypt for help and trusting in Pharaoh's shadow rather than in the LORD. He declares that in returning and rest they shall be saved, and in quietness and confidence shall be their strength, but they would not. The LORD will be gracious and will wait to show them mercy, and He will destroy Assyria with His voice.

verses.kjv: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD!
verses.modern: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help and rely on horses, who trust in chariots because they are many and in horsemen because they are very strong — but they do not look to the Holy One of Israel, nor seek the LORD!

verses.kjv: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
verses.modern: Yet He also is wise and brings disaster; He does not take back His words. He will rise against the house of evildoers and against the helpers of those who do iniquity.

verses.kjv: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
verses.modern: The Egyptians are man and not God; their horses are flesh and not spirit. When the LORD stretches out His hand, the helper will stumble and the one who is helped will fall, and they will all perish together.

verses.kjv: For thus hath the LORD spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
verses.modern: For thus the LORD said to me: "As a lion or a young lion growls over His prey, and when a band of shepherds is called out against Him He is not frightened by their shouting or disturbed by their noise — so the LORD of hosts will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its hill."

verses.kjv: As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.
verses.modern: Like birds hovering, so the LORD of hosts will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and deliver it; He will spare and rescue it.

verses.kjv: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
verses.modern: Turn to Him from whom You have so deeply revolted, O children of Israel!

verses.kjv: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
verses.modern: For in that day everyone shall cast away His idols of silver and His idols of gold — which Your hands have sinfully made for You.

verses.kjv: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
verses.modern: And Assyria shall fall by a sword — not of man; a sword, not of mortals, shall devour Him. He shall flee from the sword, and His young men shall be put to forced labor.

verses.kjv: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: His rock shall pass away in terror, and His princes shall be panic-stricken at the ensign, declares the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and whose furnace is in Jerusalem.

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounces woe on those who go down to Egypt for help, trusting in horses and chariots rather than looking to the Holy One of Israel. As a lion is not frightened by shepherds, so the LORD of hosts will come down to fight for Mount Zion. Assyria will fall by a sword not of man.

verses.kjv: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
verses.modern: A king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule with justice.

verses.kjv: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
verses.modern: Each will be like a shelter from the wind, a refuge from the storm — like streams of water in a dry place, like the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

verses.kjv: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
verses.modern: The eyes of those who see will not be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

verses.kjv: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
verses.modern: The heart of the hasty will understand and know, and the tongue of the stammerers will speak readily and clearly.

verses.kjv: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, and the churl shall be said to be bountiful.
verses.modern: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel said to be honorable.

verses.kjv: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.modern: For the fool speaks foolishness, and his heart is set on doing evil — to practice ungodliness, to speak error against the LORD, to leave the hungry unfed and to deprive the thirsty of drink.

verses.kjv: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
verses.modern: The scoundrel's methods are wicked. He devises evil schemes to ruin the poor with false words, even when the plea of the needy is just.

verses.kjv: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
verses.modern: But the noble plans noble things; He stands firm in His noble purposes.

verses.kjv: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
verses.modern: Rise up, You women who are at ease; hear my voice. You complacent daughters, listen to my words.

verses.kjv: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
verses.modern: In little more than a year You will tremble, You complacent women, for the grape harvest shall fail; the harvest shall not come.

verses.kjv: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.
verses.modern: Shudder, You women who are at ease! Tremble, You complacent ones! Strip yourselves bare and put sackcloth around Your waist.

verses.kjv: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.modern: Beat Your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine,

verses.kjv: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
verses.modern: for the ground of my people growing up thorns and briers — yes, for all the joyful houses in the exultant city.

verses.kjv: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
verses.modern: For the palace is forsaken; the noisy city is deserted. The hill and the watchtower have become dens forever — a delight of wild donkeys, a pasture for flocks —

verses.kjv: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
verses.modern: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is regarded as a forest.

verses.kjv: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
verses.modern: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness abide in the fruitful field.

verses.kjv: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
verses.modern: The work of righteousness shall be peace; the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.

verses.kjv: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
verses.modern: My people shall live in a peaceful settlement, in safe homes, in quiet resting places.

verses.kjv: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
verses.modern: Even when the forest falls down and the city is utterly laid low,

verses.kjv: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
verses.modern: blessed are You who sow beside all waters, who let the feet of the ox and donkey range freely.

chapters.summary: Isaiah prophesies that a king will reign in righteousness and princes will rule in justice. Eyes that see will not be dim and ears that hear will listen. The careless women are warned that within a year they will tremble, for the harvest will fail. When the Spirit is poured out from on high, the wilderness will become a fruitful field and righteousness will produce peace.

verses.kjv: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
verses.modern: Woe to You, destroyer, who Yourself have not been destroyed — you traitor, whom no one has betrayed! When you stop destroying, you will be destroyed. When You stop betraying, they will betray You.

verses.kjv: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.modern: O LORD, be gracious to us; we wait for You. Be our arm every morning — our salvation in time of trouble.

verses.kjv: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
verses.modern: At the sound of the tumult, peoples flee; when You rise up, nations scatter.

verses.kjv: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
verses.modern: Your plunder is gathered as the caterpillar gathers; as locusts leap, men leap on it.

verses.kjv: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
verses.modern: The LORD is exalted, for He dwells on high; He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

verses.kjv: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is his treasure.
verses.modern: He will be the stability of Your times — wealth of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is His treasure.

verses.kjv: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
verses.modern: Their brave men cry in the streets; the envoys of peace weep bitterly.

verses.kjv: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
verses.modern: The highways are deserted; the wayfarer ceases. The covenant is broken; the cities are despised; man is not regarded.

verses.kjv: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
verses.modern: The land mourns and withers. Lebanon is ashamed and withers. Sharon is like a wilderness, and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruit.

verses.kjv: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
verses.modern: "Now I will rise," says the LORD. "Now I will be exalted; now I will lift Myself up.

verses.kjv: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
verses.modern: You conceive chaff; You give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will consume You.

verses.kjv: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
verses.modern: The peoples shall be as if burned to lime — like thorns cut down, they shall be burned in the fire."

verses.kjv: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
verses.modern: Hear, You who are far off, what I have done; and you who are near, acknowledge My might.

verses.kjv: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
verses.modern: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling has seized the godless: "Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burnings?"

verses.kjv: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
verses.modern: He who walks righteously and speaks honestly — who despises the gain of oppressions, who shakes His hands free of bribes, who stops His ears from hearing of bloodshed and shuts His eyes from looking on evil —

verses.kjv: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
verses.modern: he shall dwell on the heights. His place of defense shall be the fortress of rocks; His bread will be given Him, His water will be sure.

verses.kjv: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
verses.modern: Your eyes shall see the king in his beauty; they shall see a land that stretches far.

verses.kjv: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
verses.modern: Your heart shall ponder the terror: "Where is the one who counted? Where is the one who weighed the tribute? Where is the one who counted the towers?"

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
verses.modern: You shall no longer see that fierce people — a people of obscure speech you could not understand, of a stammering tongue you could not comprehend.

verses.kjv: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
verses.modern: Look on Zion, the city of our appointed feasts! Your eyes shall see Jerusalem, a quiet home, a tent that shall not be moved. Its stakes shall never be pulled up, and none of its cords shall be broken.

verses.kjv: But there the glorious LORD will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
verses.modern: But there the glorious LORD will be for us a place of broad rivers and streams where no galley with oars can go, where no mighty ship can pass.

verses.kjv: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; he will save us.
verses.modern: For the LORD is our Judge; the LORD is our Lawgiver; the LORD is our King. He will save us.

verses.kjv: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
verses.modern: Your tackle hangs loose; it cannot hold the mast firm or spread the sail. Then plunder and spoil in abundance will be divided; even the lame shall take the plunder.

verses.kjv: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
verses.modern: No inhabitant shall say, "I am sick." The people who live there will be forgiven their iniquity.

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounces woe on the destroyer who was not destroyed and the treacherous dealer. Isaiah calls on the LORD to be gracious, for He is the stability of Zion's times. The LORD will be the judge, lawgiver, and king who saves His people. Zion will see Jerusalem as a quiet habitation, and the inhabitants will not say they are sick, for the people who dwell there will be forgiven their iniquity.

verses.kjv: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
verses.modern: Draw near, O nations, to hear; listen, O peoples. Let the earth hear, and all that fills it — the world and all that comes from it.

verses.kjv: For the indignation of the LORD is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
verses.modern: For the LORD is enraged against all the nations and furious against all their armies. He has devoted them to destruction and given them over to slaughter.

verses.kjv: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
verses.modern: Their slain shall be cast out, and the stench of their corpses shall rise. The mountains shall flow with their blood.

verses.kjv: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
verses.modern: All the host of heaven shall rot away, and the skies shall roll up like a scroll. All their host shall fall like leaves falling from the vine — like leaves falling from the fig tree.

verses.kjv: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
verses.modern: For My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens; it shall come down on Edom — on the people I have given over to judgment.

verses.kjv: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
verses.modern: The sword of the LORD is bathed in blood; it is gorged with fat — the blood of lambs and goats, the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

verses.kjv: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
verses.modern: The unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls. Their land shall be soaked with blood, and their soil made rich with fat.

verses.kjv: For it is the day of the LORD's vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
verses.modern: For the LORD has a day of vengeance — a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

verses.kjv: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
verses.modern: Its streams shall be turned into pitch and its soil into sulfur; its land shall become burning pitch.

verses.kjv: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
verses.modern: Night and day it shall not be quenched; its smoke shall go up forever. From generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.

verses.kjv: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
verses.modern: The cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl and the raven shall dwell in it. He shall stretch over it the line of confusion and the stones of emptiness.

verses.kjv: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
verses.modern: Its nobles shall be nothing; they shall call the kingdom itself nothing. All its princes shall come to nothing.

verses.kjv: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
verses.modern: Thorns shall grow over its strongholds, nettles and brambles in its fortresses. It shall be a home for dragons and a court for owls.

verses.kjv: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
verses.modern: The wild beasts of the desert shall meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to His fellow. The screech owl shall rest there and find herself a place of rest.

verses.kjv: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
verses.modern: There the great owl shall make her nest and lay and hatch, and gather her young under her shadow. There shall the vultures be gathered, every one with her mate.

verses.kjv: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
verses.modern: Seek and read from the book of the LORD: not one of these shall be missing; none shall be without her mate. For the mouth of the LORD has commanded it, and His Spirit has gathered them.

verses.kjv: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
verses.modern: He has cast the lot for them; his hand has apportioned it to them with the measuring line. They shall possess it forever; from generation to generation they shall dwell in it.

chapters.summary: The LORD summons all nations to hear His fury. His sword will come down on Edom, and the land will become burning pitch. The streams of Edom will be turned to pitch, its dust to brimstone, and it will not be quenched night or day. The wild beasts of the desert will possess it forever.

verses.kjv: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
verses.modern: The wilderness and the dry land shall be glad; the desert shall rejoice and blossom like the rose.

verses.kjv: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD, and the excellency of our God.
verses.modern: It shall blossom abundantly and rejoice with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon shall be given to it, the majesty of Carmel and Sharon. They shall see the glory of the LORD, the majesty of our God.

verses.kjv: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
verses.modern: Strengthen the weak hands and make firm the feeble knees.

verses.kjv: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.
verses.modern: Say to those who are anxious in heart: "Be strong; do not be afraid! Your God will come with vengeance — with divine recompense. He will come and save You."

verses.kjv: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
verses.modern: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf unstopped.

verses.kjv: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
verses.modern: Then the lame man shall leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute shall sing for joy. Waters shall break forth in the wilderness and streams in the desert.

verses.kjv: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.
verses.modern: The burning sand shall become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. In the haunt of jackals — where they lay — shall be grass with reeds and rushes.

verses.kjv: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
verses.modern: A highway shall be there, and it shall be called the Way of Holiness. The unclean shall not pass over it. It shall belong to them. The wayfaring man, even if He is a fool, shall not go astray.

verses.kjv: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
verses.modern: No lion shall be there, nor shall any ravenous beast come up on it. They shall not be found there. But the redeemed shall walk there.

verses.kjv: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.modern: The ransomed of the LORD shall return and come to Zion with singing; everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They shall obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

chapters.summary: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad, and the desert will blossom as the rose. The eyes of the blind shall be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped. The lame man shall leap like a deer and the tongue of the dumb shall sing. A highway called the way of holiness will be there, and the ransomed of the LORD shall return to Zion with singing and everlasting joy.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.
verses.modern: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

verses.kjv: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.
verses.modern: The king of Assyria sent the Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the conduit of the upper pool on the road to the field of the launderer.

verses.kjv: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's son, the recorder.
verses.modern: Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, came out to him along with Shebna the secretary and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder.

verses.kjv: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
verses.modern: The Rabshakeh said to them, "Say to Hezekiah: 'Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria: What is this confidence in which you trust?

verses.kjv: I say, sayest thou, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
verses.modern: You say — but they are empty words — "I have a plan and strength for war." On whom do you now rely, that you have rebelled against me?

verses.kjv: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
verses.modern: You are trusting in Egypt — that broken reed of a staff — which pierces the hand of any man who leans on it. That is what Pharaoh king of Egypt is to all who trust in him.

verses.kjv: But if thou say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
verses.modern: But if You say to me, "We trust in the LORD our God," is He not the One whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and to Jerusalem, "You shall worship before this altar"?

verses.kjv: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
verses.modern: Come now, make a wager with my master the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able to put riders on them.

verses.kjv: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.modern: How then can you repulse even one captain among the least of my master's servants — when you rely on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?

verses.kjv: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.modern: Moreover, have I come up against this land without the LORD? The LORD said to me, "Go up against this land and destroy it." ' "

verses.kjv: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
verses.modern: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the Rabshakeh, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it. Do not speak to us in the language of Judah in the hearing of the people on the wall."

verses.kjv: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
verses.modern: But the Rabshakeh said, "Has my master sent me to speak these words to Your master and to You — and not to the men sitting on the wall, who are doomed with You to eat their own dung and drink their own urine?"

verses.kjv: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria:
verses.modern: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out in a loud voice in the language of Judah: "Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

verses.kjv: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
verses.modern: Thus says the king: 'Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you.

verses.kjv: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.modern: Do not let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, "The LORD will surely deliver us. This city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria."

verses.kjv: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;
verses.modern: Do not listen to Hezekiah.' For thus says the king of Assyria: 'Make peace with me and come out to me. Then each of you will eat from his own vine and his own fig tree and drink from his own cistern,

verses.kjv: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.modern: until I come and take you to a land like your own land — a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

verses.kjv: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.modern: Beware lest Hezekiah mislead you by saying, "The LORD will deliver us." Has any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.kjv: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
verses.modern: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Did they deliver Samaria from my hand?

verses.kjv: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
verses.modern: Who among all the gods of these lands have delivered their lands from my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem from my hand?' "

verses.kjv: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.modern: But they were silent and answered him not a word, for the king's command was, "Do not answer him."

verses.kjv: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.modern: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, Shebna the secretary, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn and told him the words of the Rabshakeh.

chapters.summary: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against the fortified cities of Judah. Rabshakeh stood before the walls of Jerusalem and mocked the God of Israel, urging the people to surrender and not trust in Hezekiah or the LORD.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes and covered Himself with sackcloth and went into the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.modern: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the secretary, and the senior priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
verses.modern: They said to him, "Thus says Hezekiah: This day is a day of distress, of rebuke, and of disgrace. Children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to bring them forth.

verses.kjv: It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.
verses.modern: It may be that the LORD Your God will hear the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to mock the living God, and will rebuke the words that the LORD Your God has heard. Therefore lift up Your prayer for the remnant that is left."

verses.kjv: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.modern: The servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

verses.kjv: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.modern: Isaiah said to them, "Say to your master: 'Thus says the LORD: Do not be afraid because of the words You have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have mocked Me.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
verses.modern: I will put a spirit in Him, so that He shall hear a rumor and return to His own land. And I will make Him fall by the sword in His own land.' "

verses.kjv: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
verses.modern: The Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah, for he had heard that the king had left Lachish.

verses.kjv: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.modern: Now the king heard concerning Tirhakah king of Cush, "He has set out to fight against you." When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.modern: "Say this to Hezekiah king of Judah: 'Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you by saying that Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?
verses.modern: You have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands — destroying them utterly. And shall you be delivered?

verses.kjv: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?
verses.modern: Did the gods of the nations deliver them — the nations my fathers destroyed — Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden who were in Telassar?

verses.kjv: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?
verses.modern: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, the king of the city of Sepharvaim, the king of Hena, and the king of Ivah?' "

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
verses.modern: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then He went up to the house of the LORD and spread it before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah prayed unto the LORD, saying,
verses.modern: Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying:

verses.kjv: O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.
verses.modern: "O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, who is enthroned above the cherubim — You alone are the God of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

verses.kjv: Incline thine ear, O LORD, and hear; open thine eyes, O LORD, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.
verses.modern: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and hear. Open Your eyes, O LORD, and see. Hear all the words of Sennacherib, who has sent to mock the living God.

verses.kjv: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
verses.modern: Truly, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations and their lands,

verses.kjv: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
verses.modern: and have cast their gods into the fire — for they were not gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone. Therefore they were destroyed.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD, even thou only.
verses.modern: So now, O LORD our God, save us from His hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone are the LORD."

verses.kjv: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:
verses.modern: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, "Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel: Because You have prayed to Me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,

verses.kjv: This is the word which the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
verses.modern: this is the word the LORD has spoken concerning Him: 'The virgin daughter of Zion despises You and mocks You; the daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head at You.

verses.kjv: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.modern: Whom have You mocked and blasphemed? Against whom have You raised Your voice and lifted Your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel!

verses.kjv: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.
verses.modern: By Your servants You have mocked the Lord, and You have said, "With my many chariots I have gone up to the heights of the mountains, to the far reaches of Lebanon. I cut down its tall cedars and its choicest cypress trees. I came to its remotest summit, its densest forest.

verses.kjv: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.
verses.modern: I dug wells and drank water; I dried up with the sole of my foot all the streams of Egypt."

verses.kjv: Hast thou not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.
verses.modern: Have You not heard that I determined long ago what I am now bringing to pass? I planned from ancient days that You would crush fortified cities into heaps of ruins.

verses.kjv: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
verses.modern: Their inhabitants had little power; they were dismayed and ashamed. They were like plants of the field, like tender green shoots, like grass on the housetops — blighted before it grows up.

verses.kjv: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
verses.modern: I know Your sitting down, Your going out and Your coming in, and Your raging against Me.

verses.kjv: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
verses.modern: Because Your raging against Me and Your arrogance have come to My ears, I will put My hook in Your nose and My bit in Your mouth, and I will turn You back on the way by which You came.'

verses.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
verses.modern: "And this shall be the sign for You: this year eat what grows of itself, in the second year what springs from that, and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

verses.kjv: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:
verses.modern: The surviving remnant of the house of Judah shall again take root downward and bear fruit upward.

verses.kjv: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.
verses.modern: For out of Jerusalem shall go a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will accomplish this.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.
verses.modern: Therefore thus says the LORD concerning the king of Assyria: He shall not come into this city or shoot an arrow there. He shall not come before it with a shield or cast up a siege ramp against it.

verses.kjv: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: By the way that He came, by the same He shall return. He shall not come into this city, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
verses.modern: For I will defend this city to save it — for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David."

verses.kjv: Then the angel of the LORD went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
verses.modern: The angel of the LORD went out and struck down 185,000 in the camp of the Assyrians. When people arose early in the morning, there were all the dead bodies.

verses.kjv: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
verses.modern: So Sennacherib king of Assyria left and returned home and lived at Nineveh.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: As He was worshiping in the house of Nisroch His god, His sons Adrammelech and Sharezer struck Him down with the sword and escaped into the land of Ararat. Esarhaddon His son reigned in His place.

chapters.summary: Hezekiah tore his clothes and went into the house of the LORD, then sent to Isaiah for a word from God. Isaiah declared that the LORD would put a hook in Sennacherib's nose and turn him back. Hezekiah spread Sennacherib's threatening letter before the LORD and prayed, and that night the angel of the LORD struck down 185,000 Assyrians.

verses.kjv: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.
verses.modern: In those days Hezekiah became sick and was near death. Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him and said, "Thus says the LORD: Set Your house in order, for You shall die and not recover."

verses.kjv: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the LORD,
verses.modern: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD:

verses.kjv: And said, Remember now, O LORD, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
verses.modern: "Please, O LORD, remember how I have walked before You in faithfulness and with a whole heart, and have done what is good in Your sight." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

verses.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD to Isaiah, saying,
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD came to Isaiah:

verses.kjv: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
verses.modern: "Go and say to Hezekiah: Thus says the LORD, the God of David your father: I have heard your prayer; I have seen Your tears. I will add fifteen years to Your life.

verses.kjv: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
verses.modern: I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria and defend this city.
