verses.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he hath spoken;
verses.modern: This is the sign to You from the LORD that the LORD will do this thing that He has spoken:

verses.kjv: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
verses.modern: I will make the shadow on the sundial of Ahaz go back ten steps." So the sun turned back ten steps on the dial by which it had gone down.

verses.kjv: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
verses.modern: A writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, after he had been sick and had recovered from his sickness:

verses.kjv: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
verses.modern: I said, "In the middle of my days I must depart. I am consigned to the gates of hell for the rest of my years."

verses.kjv: I said, I shall not see the LORD, even the LORD, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
verses.modern: I said, "I shall not see the LORD — the LORD — in the land of the living. I shall look on man no more among the inhabitants of the world."

verses.kjv: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.modern: My dwelling has been pulled up and removed from me like a shepherd's tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver who cuts me off from the loom; from day to night You bring me to an end.

verses.kjv: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.modern: I kept myself calm until morning — but like a lion He breaks all my bones. From day to night You bring me to an end.

verses.kjv: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O LORD, I am oppressed; undertake for me.
verses.modern: Like a swallow or a crane I chirp; I moan like a dove. My eyes are weary from looking upward. O LORD, I am in distress; be my pledge of safety!

verses.kjv: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.modern: What shall I say? For He has spoken to me, and He Himself has done it. I walk slowly all my years because of the bitterness of my soul.

verses.kjv: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
verses.modern: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these is the life of my spirit. Restore me to health and make me live!

verses.kjv: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
verses.modern: In peace I had great bitterness — but in love You delivered my soul from the pit of destruction. For You have cast all my sins behind Your back.

verses.kjv: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
verses.modern: For hell cannot praise You; death cannot celebrate You. Those who go down to the pit cannot hope for Your faithfulness.

verses.kjv: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
verses.modern: The living — the living — he praises You, as I do this day. The father tells the children about Your faithfulness.

verses.kjv: The LORD was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: The LORD will save me, and we will sing my songs on stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
verses.modern: Now Isaiah had said, "Let them take a cake of figs and apply it as a poultice to the boil, and He shall recover."

verses.kjv: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?
verses.modern: Hezekiah also had said, "What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?"

chapters.summary: Hezekiah fell sick to the point of death, and Isaiah told him to set his house in order. Hezekiah prayed and wept, and the LORD added fifteen years to his life and delivered Jerusalem from Assyria. Hezekiah wrote a song of thanksgiving, praising the LORD who cast all his sins behind His back.

verses.kjv: At that time Merodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.
verses.modern: At that time Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent envoys with letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been sick and had recovered.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
verses.modern: Hezekiah welcomed them gladly and showed them his treasure house — the silver, the gold, the spices, the precious oil, his whole armory, and all that was found in his treasuries. There was nothing in his house or in all his realm that Hezekiah did not show them.

verses.kjv: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.
verses.modern: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him, "What did these men say, and from where did they come to you?" Hezekiah said, "They came to me from a far country — from Babylon."

verses.kjv: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
verses.modern: He said, "What have they seen in your house?" Hezekiah answered, "They have seen everything in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them."

verses.kjv: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:
verses.modern: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: The days are coming when all that is in Your house and all that Your fathers have stored up until this day shall be carried away to Babylon. Nothing shall be left, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
verses.modern: Some of your own sons who will come from you — whom you will father — shall be taken away, and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."

verses.kjv: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
verses.modern: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "The word of the LORD that you have spoken is good." For He thought, "There will be peace and truth in my days."

chapters.summary: Hezekiah showed the envoys of Merodachbaladan of Babylon all his treasure house, his armory, and everything in his storehouses. Isaiah rebuked him and prophesied that everything in the palace would one day be carried to Babylon, and his own descendants would serve as eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
verses.modern: "Comfort, comfort My people," says Your God.

verses.kjv: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the LORD's hand double for all her sins.
verses.modern: Speak tenderly to Jerusalem and proclaim to her that her hard service is ended — that her iniquity is pardoned — for she has received from the LORD's hand double for all her sins.

verses.kjv: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
verses.modern: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: "Prepare the way of the LORD; make straight in the desert a highway for our God."

verses.kjv: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
verses.modern: Every valley shall be lifted up, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain.

verses.kjv: And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.modern: The glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together, for the mouth of the LORD has spoken.

verses.kjv: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
verses.modern: A voice says, "Cry!" And He said, "What shall I cry?" All flesh is grass, and all its beauty is like the flower of the field.

verses.kjv: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
verses.modern: The grass withers, the flower fades when the breath of the LORD blows on it. The people are grass.

verses.kjv: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
verses.modern: The grass withers, the flower fades, but the word of our God shall stand forever.

verses.kjv: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
verses.modern: Go up on a high mountain, O Zion, bearer of good news. Lift up Your voice with strength, O Jerusalem, bearer of good news. Lift it up; do not be afraid. Say to the cities of Judah, "Here is Your God!"

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
verses.modern: The Lord GOD comes with might, and His arm rules for Him. His reward is with Him, and His recompense before Him.

verses.kjv: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
verses.modern: He tends his flock like a shepherd. He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart. He gently leads those that are with young.

verses.kjv: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
verses.modern: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of His hand and marked off the heavens with a span — enclosed the dust of the earth in a measure and weighed the mountains in scales and the hills in a balance?

verses.kjv: Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or being his counsellor hath taught him?
verses.modern: Who has directed the Spirit of the LORD, or as His counselor has taught Him?

verses.kjv: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?
verses.modern: Whom did He consult, and who gave Him understanding and taught Him the path of justice? Who taught Him knowledge and showed Him the way of understanding?

verses.kjv: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
verses.modern: The nations are like a drop from a bucket and are counted as the dust on the scales. He takes up the coastlands like fine dust.

verses.kjv: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
verses.modern: Lebanon would not suffice for fuel, nor its animals enough for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
verses.modern: All the nations are as nothing before him; they are counted by Him as less than nothing and emptiness.

verses.kjv: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
verses.modern: To whom then will You compare God? Or what likeness will You compare to Him?

verses.kjv: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.
verses.modern: A craftsman casts an idol, and a goldsmith overlays it with gold and casts silver chains for it.

verses.kjv: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.
verses.modern: He who is too poor for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks out a skilled craftsman to set up an idol that will not totter.

verses.kjv: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
verses.modern: Have You not known? Have You not heard? Has it not been told You from the beginning? Have You not understood from the foundations of the earth?

verses.kjv: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
verses.modern: It is He who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in.

verses.kjv: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.
verses.modern: He brings princes to nothing and makes the rulers of the earth as emptiness.

verses.kjv: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
verses.modern: Scarcely are they planted, scarcely sown, scarcely has their stem taken root in the earth, when He blows on them and they wither, and the wind carries them off like stubble.

verses.kjv: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.
verses.modern: "To whom then will You compare Me — that I should be equal?" says the Holy One.

verses.kjv: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.
verses.modern: Lift up Your eyes on high and see: Who created these? He who brings out their host by number, calling them all by name. Because of the greatness of His might and the strength of His power, not one is missing.

verses.kjv: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the LORD, and my judgment is passed over from my God?
verses.modern: Why do You say, O Jacob, and speak, O Israel, "My way is hidden from the LORD, and my just cause is disregarded by my God"?

verses.kjv: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
verses.modern: Have You not known? Have You not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He does not faint or grow weary; His understanding is unsearchable.

verses.kjv: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
verses.modern: He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of those who have none.

verses.kjv: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
verses.modern: Even youths shall faint and grow weary, and young men shall fall exhausted;

verses.kjv: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.modern: but those who wait on the LORD shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings like eagles. They shall run and not be weary; they shall walk and not faint.

chapters.summary: The LORD declares, 'Comfort My people,' and commands a voice to cry in the wilderness to prepare the way of the LORD. All flesh is grass, but the word of God stands forever. He who sits above the circle of the earth gives power to the faint, and those who wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength, mount up with wings as eagles, run and not be weary, walk and not faint.

verses.kjv: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
verses.modern: Be silent before Me, O coastlands; let the peoples renew their strength. Let them approach and speak; let us come together for judgment.

verses.kjv: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.
verses.modern: Who stirred up one from the east whom victory meets at every step? He gives up nations before Him, so that He tramples kings underfoot. He makes them like dust with his sword and like wind-blown chaff with his bow.

verses.kjv: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.
verses.modern: He pursues them and passes on safely, by paths His feet have not trodden.

verses.kjv: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the LORD, the first, and with the last; I am he.
verses.modern: Who has done and brought this about — calling forth the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD, the first, and with the last — I am He.

verses.kjv: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.
verses.modern: The coastlands see it and are afraid; the ends of the earth tremble. They draw near and come.

verses.kjv: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.
verses.modern: Everyone helps His neighbor and says to His brother, "Be strong!"

verses.kjv: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
verses.modern: The craftsman encourages the goldsmith, and the one who smooths with the hammer encourages the one who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, "It is good." Then He fastens it with nails so it cannot be moved.

verses.kjv: But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.
verses.modern: But you, Israel, My servant — Jacob, whom I have chosen — you are the seed of Abraham My friend.

verses.kjv: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.
verses.modern: I took you from the ends of the earth and called you from its farthest corners, saying to you, "You are My servant. I have chosen you and not cast you off."

verses.kjv: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
verses.modern: Do not fear, for I am with you. Do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.

verses.kjv: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.
verses.modern: All who rage against you shall be put to shame and be disgraced. Those who fight against you shall be as nothing and shall perish.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
verses.modern: You shall seek those who strive against you, but shall not find them. Those who war against you shall be as nothing at all.

verses.kjv: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
verses.modern: For I, the LORD Your God, hold Your right hand. It is I who say to You, "Do not fear; I will help You."

verses.kjv: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the LORD, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.modern: Do not fear, You worm Jacob, you few men of Israel! I will help you, says the LORD; Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.
verses.modern: I will make You a new threshing sledge with many sharp teeth. You shall thresh the mountains and crush them, and make the hills like chaff.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the LORD, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.modern: You shall winnow them, and the wind shall carry them away — the storm shall scatter them. You shall rejoice in the LORD and glory in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the LORD will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.
verses.modern: When the poor and needy seek water and there is none — their tongue parched with thirst — I the LORD will answer them. The God of Israel will not forsake them.

verses.kjv: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
verses.modern: I will open rivers in bare heights and fountains in the midst of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water and the dry land springs of water.

verses.kjv: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:
verses.modern: I will put in the wilderness the cedar, the acacia, the myrtle, and the olive tree. I will place in the desert the cypress, the plane, and the pine together,

verses.kjv: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the LORD hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
verses.modern: so that they may see and know, may consider and understand together, that the hand of the LORD has done this — the Holy One of Israel has created it.

verses.kjv: Produce your cause, saith the LORD; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.
verses.modern: "Present Your case," says the LORD. "Bring forward Your strong arguments," says the King of Jacob.

verses.kjv: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.
verses.modern: Let them bring and tell us what will happen. Tell us the former things — what they were — so that we may consider them and know their outcome. Or declare to us the things to come.

verses.kjv: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.
verses.modern: Tell us what is to come in the future, so we may know that You are gods. Do good, or do harm — that we may be filled with awe and fear.

verses.kjv: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.
verses.modern: You are less than nothing, and Your deeds are empty. Whoever chooses you is detestable.

verses.kjv: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.
verses.modern: I stirred up one from the north, and He has come — from the rising of the sun He calls on My name. He tramples on rulers like mortar, as the potter treads clay.

verses.kjv: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.
verses.modern: Who declared this from the beginning, so that we could know — or beforehand, that we might say, "He is right"? No one declared it, no one proclaimed it, no one heard your words.

verses.kjv: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.
verses.modern: I was the first to say to Zion, "Here they are!" and to Jerusalem, "I will give You a herald of good news."

verses.kjv: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
verses.modern: But when I look, there is no one — no one among them to give counsel; not one who can answer when I ask.

verses.kjv: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.
verses.modern: They are all nothing; their works are empty. Their metal images are wind and confusion.

chapters.summary: The LORD challenges the nations to bring their case before Him and asks who raised up the righteous man from the east. He declares to Israel, 'Fear not, for I am with you; I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you.' He will open rivers on bare heights and make the wilderness a pool of water. The idols of the nations are nothing, and their works are vanity.

verses.kjv: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.modern: Here is My servant, whom I uphold — My chosen one, in whom My soul delights. I have put My Spirit on Him; He shall bring justice to the nations.

verses.kjv: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
verses.modern: He shall not cry out or raise His voice; He shall not make it heard in the street.

verses.kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment in truth.
verses.modern: A bruised reed He shall not break, and a smoldering wick He shall not quench. He shall bring forth justice in truth.

verses.kjv: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.
verses.modern: He shall not grow faint or be discouraged until He has established justice in the earth. The coastlands wait for His law.

verses.kjv: Thus saith God the LORD, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
verses.modern: Thus says God the LORD — who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and what comes from it, who gives breath to the people on it and spirit to those who walk in it:

verses.kjv: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
verses.modern: "I am the LORD; I have called You in righteousness. I will take You by the hand and keep You. I will give You as a covenant to the people, as a light to the nations,

verses.kjv: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.
verses.modern: to open the eyes of the blind, to bring out the prisoners from the dungeon — from the prison those who sit in darkness."

verses.kjv: I am the LORD: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
verses.modern: I am the LORD — that is My name. My glory I will not give to another, nor My praise to carved idols.

verses.kjv: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
verses.modern: The former things have come to pass, and new things I now declare. Before they spring forth I tell You of them.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.modern: Sing to the LORD a new song, His praise from the end of the earth — you who go down to the sea, and all that fills it, the coastlands and their inhabitants.

verses.kjv: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
verses.modern: Let the wilderness and its towns lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of the rocks sing — let them shout from the tops of the mountains.

verses.kjv: Let them give glory unto the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.
verses.modern: Let them give glory to the LORD and declare His praise in the coastlands.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
verses.modern: The LORD goes out like a warrior — like a man of war he stirs up his zeal. He cries out and roars; He prevails against His enemies.

verses.kjv: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
verses.modern: For a long time I have been silent; I have held Myself back and restrained Myself. Now I will cry out like a woman in labor — I will gasp and pant.

verses.kjv: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.
verses.modern: I will lay waste mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation. I will turn rivers into dry land and dry up the pools.

verses.kjv: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
verses.modern: I will lead the blind in ways they do not know; in paths that they have not known I will guide them. I will turn darkness before them into light and the rough places into level ground. These are the things I will do, and I will not forsake them.

verses.kjv: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.
verses.modern: They shall be turned back and utterly ashamed — those who trust in carved images, who say to metal idols, "You are our gods."

verses.kjv: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.
verses.modern: Hear, You deaf; look, you blind, that you may see!

verses.kjv: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD's servant?
verses.modern: Who is blind but My servant, or deaf like My messenger whom I send? Who is blind like My dedicated one, or blind like the servant of the LORD?

verses.kjv: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.
verses.modern: You see many things, but You do not observe them. His ears are open, but He does not hear.

verses.kjv: The LORD is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.
verses.modern: The LORD was pleased, for His righteousness' sake, to make His law great and glorious.

verses.kjv: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.
verses.modern: But this is a people plundered and looted; all of them are trapped in holes or hidden in prisons. They have become plunder with no one to rescue, spoil with no one to say, "Restore!"

verses.kjv: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
verses.modern: Who among You will listen to this? Who will pay attention and hear for the time to come?

verses.kjv: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
verses.modern: Who gave up Jacob to be plundered, and Israel to the robbers? Was it not the LORD — He against whom we sinned? For they would not walk in His ways and would not obey His law.

verses.kjv: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
verses.modern: So He poured on Him the heat of His anger and the violence of war. It set Him on fire all around, but He did not understand. It burned Him, but He did not take it to heart.

chapters.summary: The LORD presents His Servant, on whom He has put His Spirit, who will bring justice to the nations. He will not cry out or raise His voice in the streets, and a bruised reed He will not break. The LORD calls this Servant as a covenant for the people and a light to the nations. Israel is blind and deaf though the LORD made them His witnesses.

verses.kjv: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
verses.modern: But now thus says the LORD — He who created you, O Jacob, he who formed you, O Israel: "Do not fear, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by name; you are Mine.

verses.kjv: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
verses.modern: When You pass through the waters, I will be with You. When You pass through the rivers, they shall not sweep over You. When You walk through the fire, You shall not be burned — the flame shall not consume You.

verses.kjv: For I am the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
verses.modern: For I am the LORD Your God, the Holy One of Israel, Your Savior. I give Egypt as Your ransom — Cush and Seba in exchange for You.

verses.kjv: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
verses.modern: Because You are precious in My eyes and honored, and I love You, I give men in return for You and peoples in exchange for Your life.

verses.kjv: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
verses.modern: Do not fear, for I am with You. I will bring Your offspring from the east and gather You from the west.

verses.kjv: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
verses.modern: I will say to the north, 'Give them up,' and to the south, 'Do not hold them back.' Bring My sons from afar and My daughters from the ends of the earth —

verses.kjv: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
verses.modern: everyone who is called by My name, whom I created for My glory — whom I formed and made."

verses.kjv: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
verses.modern: Bring out the people who are blind, yet have eyes — who are deaf, yet have ears!

verses.kjv: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
verses.modern: All the nations gather together, and the peoples assemble. Who among them can declare this and show us the former things? Let them bring their witnesses to prove themselves right, that they may hear and say, "It is true."

verses.kjv: Ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
verses.modern: "You are My witnesses," declares the LORD, "and My servant whom I have chosen, so that You may know and believe Me and understand that I am He. Before Me no god was formed, nor shall there be any after Me.

verses.kjv: I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no saviour.
verses.modern: I, even I, am the LORD, and besides Me there is no savior.

verses.kjv: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, that I am God.
verses.modern: I declared, saved, and proclaimed — when there was no foreign god among You. You are My witnesses," declares the LORD, "and I am God.

verses.kjv: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
verses.modern: Yes, and from ancient days I am He. There is no one who can deliver from My hand. I act, and who can reverse it?"

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD, Your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "For Your sake I send to Babylon and bring them all down as fugitives — even the Chaldeans, in the ships that were their boast."

verses.kjv: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
verses.modern: I am the LORD, Your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, Your King.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD — who makes a way in the sea and a path in the mighty waters,

verses.kjv: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
verses.modern: who brings forth chariot and horse, army and warrior — they lie down together; they cannot rise; they are extinguished, quenched like a wick:

verses.kjv: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
verses.modern: "Do not remember the former things, nor consider the things of old.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.modern: I am about to do a new thing. Now it is springing forth — do You not perceive it? I will make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert.

verses.kjv: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
verses.modern: The beast of the field shall honor Me — the dragons and the owls — for I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to My chosen people,

verses.kjv: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
verses.modern: the people whom I formed for Myself that they might declare My praise.

verses.kjv: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
verses.modern: Yet you have not called on Me, O Jacob. You have grown weary of Me, O Israel.

verses.kjv: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.
verses.modern: You have not brought Me your burnt offering sheep or honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings or wearied you with incense.

verses.kjv: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
verses.modern: You have not bought Me sweet cane with money, nor satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices. Instead, you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities.

verses.kjv: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
verses.modern: I, I am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake, and I will not remember your sins.

verses.kjv: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
verses.modern: Remind Me; let us argue together. Set forth your case, that you may be proved right.

verses.kjv: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
verses.modern: Your first father sinned, and your mediators transgressed against Me.

verses.kjv: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.
verses.modern: Therefore I profaned the princes of the sanctuary; I gave Jacob over to utter destruction and Israel to mockery.

chapters.summary: The LORD declares, 'Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine.' When Israel passes through the waters, the LORD will be with them. He blots out their transgressions for His own sake and will not remember their sins. He is doing a new thing -- making a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert.

verses.kjv: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:
verses.modern: Yet now hear, O Jacob My servant — Israel, whom I have chosen!

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD Who made You, who formed You from the womb and will help You: "Do not fear, O Jacob My servant — Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

verses.kjv: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
verses.modern: For I will pour water on the thirsty land and streams on the dry ground. I will pour My Spirit on Your offspring and My blessing on Your descendants.

verses.kjv: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
verses.modern: They shall spring up among the grass like willows by flowing streams.

verses.kjv: One shall say, I am the LORD's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the LORD, and surname himself by the name of Israel.
verses.modern: One shall say, 'I am the LORD's'; another shall call Himself by the name of Jacob; yet another shall write on his hand, 'The LORD's,' and name Himself by the name of Israel."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD, the King of Israel and his Redeemer, the LORD of hosts: "I am the first and I am the last; besides Me there is no God.

verses.kjv: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
verses.modern: Who is like Me? Let Him proclaim it. Let Him declare and lay it out before Me — who has announced from of old the things to come? Let them tell us what is yet to be.

verses.kjv: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.
verses.modern: Do not fear or be afraid. Have I not told You from of old and declared it? You are My witnesses! Is there a God besides Me? There is no Rock; I know not any."

verses.kjv: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
verses.modern: All who make carved idols are nothing, and the things they treasure are worthless. Their witnesses see nothing and know nothing — so they will be put to shame.

verses.kjv: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?
verses.modern: Who fashions a god or casts an idol that is profitable for nothing?

verses.kjv: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.
verses.modern: All His companions shall be put to shame; the craftsmen are only human. Let them all assemble and stand. They shall be terrified; they shall be put to shame together.

verses.kjv: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
verses.modern: The ironsmith takes a tool and works it over the coals. He fashions it with hammers and works it with His strong arm. He grows hungry, and His strength fails. He drinks no water and is faint.

verses.kjv: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
verses.modern: The carpenter measures with a line and marks it with a pencil. He shapes it with planes and marks it with a compass. He shapes it into the figure of a man, with the beauty of a man, to dwell in a house.

verses.kjv: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.
verses.modern: He cuts down cedars — or chooses a cypress or an oak — letting it grow strong among the trees of the forest. He plants a cedar and the rain nourishes it.

verses.kjv: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
verses.modern: Then it becomes fuel for a man — he takes part of it and warms himself; he kindles a fire and bakes bread. He also makes a god and worships it; He makes a carved image and bows down to it.

verses.kjv: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
verses.modern: Half of it He burns in the fire. With that half He roasts meat and is satisfied. He also warms Himself and says, "I am warm; I have seen the fire!"

verses.kjv: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.
verses.modern: The other half He makes into a god — His idol. He bows down to it and worships it. He prays to it and says, "Deliver me, for You are my god!"

verses.kjv: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
verses.modern: They do not know; they do not understand. Their eyes are closed so they cannot see, and their hearts, so they cannot understand.

verses.kjv: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
verses.modern: No one reflects, no one has knowledge or understanding to say, "Half of it I burned in the fire. I also baked bread on its coals and roasted meat and ate it. Shall I make the rest of it detestable? Shall I fall down before a block of wood?"

verses.kjv: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
verses.modern: He is feeding on ashes; a deluded heart has led Him astray. He cannot deliver Himself or say, "Is there not a lie in my right hand?"

verses.kjv: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.
verses.modern: Remember these things, O Jacob — and Israel, for you are My servant. I formed you; you are My servant. O Israel, you will not be forgotten by Me.

verses.kjv: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
verses.modern: I have swept away your transgressions like a cloud and your sins like a mist. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.

verses.kjv: Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.
verses.modern: Sing, O heavens, for the LORD has done it! Shout, O depths of the earth! Break forth in singing, O mountains — O forest, and every tree in it! For the LORD has redeemed Jacob and glorified himself in Israel.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the LORD that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD, Your Redeemer — who formed You from the womb: "I am the LORD, who made all things, who alone stretched out the heavens, who spread out the earth by Myself,

verses.kjv: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
verses.modern: who foils the omens of boasters and makes diviners look foolish, who turns wise men back and makes their knowledge nonsense,

verses.kjv: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
verses.modern: who confirms the word of His servant and fulfills the counsel of his messengers — who says of Jerusalem, 'She shall be inhabited,' and of the cities of Judah, 'They shall be built, and I will raise up their ruins,'

verses.kjv: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
verses.modern: who says to the deep, 'Be dry; I will dry up Your rivers,'

verses.kjv: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.
verses.modern: who says of Cyrus, 'He is My shepherd, and he shall carry out all My purpose, saying of Jerusalem, "She shall be built," and of the temple, "Your foundation shall be laid." ' "

chapters.summary: The LORD declares that He will pour out His Spirit on the descendants of Jacob, and they shall spring up like willows by the watercourses. He is the first and the last, and beside Him there is no God. Isaiah mocks those who make idols from a block of wood -- half they burn for fire and half they worship. The LORD will redeem Jacob and declares Cyrus His shepherd.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD to His anointed — to Cyrus — whose right hand I have grasped, to subdue nations before Him and strip kings of their armor, to open doors before Him so that gates shall not be shut:

verses.kjv: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
verses.modern: "I will go before You and level the mountains. I will break in pieces the doors of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.

verses.kjv: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the LORD, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.
verses.modern: I will give You the treasures of darkness and the hoards in secret places, that You may know that I am the LORD, the God of Israel, who calls You by Your name.

verses.kjv: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
verses.modern: For the sake of Jacob My servant and Israel My chosen, I call you by your name; I give you a title of honor, though you do not know Me.

verses.kjv: I am the LORD, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
verses.modern: I am the LORD, and there is no other; besides Me there is no God. I equip You, though You do not know Me,

verses.kjv: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the LORD, and there is none else.
verses.modern: so that they may know from the rising of the sun and from the west that there is no one besides Me. I am the LORD, and there is no other.

verses.kjv: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these things.
verses.modern: I form light and create darkness; I make peace and create calamity. I am the LORD Who does all these things.

verses.kjv: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the LORD have created it.
verses.modern: Rain down, O heavens, from above; let the clouds pour down righteousness. Let the earth open and let salvation and righteousness spring up together. I the LORD have created it.

verses.kjv: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
verses.modern: Woe to Him who strives with His Maker — a clay pot among earthen vessels! Shall the clay say to the potter, "What are You making?" or "Your work has no handles"?

verses.kjv: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?
verses.modern: Woe to Him who says to His father, "What are You begetting?" or to a woman, "With what are you in labor?"

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD, the Holy One of Israel and His Maker: "Will You question Me about things to come, or give Me orders about the work of My hands?

verses.kjv: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
verses.modern: I made the earth and created man on it. It was My hands that stretched out the heavens, and I commanded all their host.

verses.kjv: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.modern: I have stirred Him up in righteousness, and I will make all His ways level. He shall build My city and set My exiles free — not for price or reward," says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD: "The wealth of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush and the Sabeans — men of tall stature — shall come over to You and be Yours. They shall follow You; they shall come over in chains and bow down to You. They will plead with You, saying, 'Surely God is in You, and there is no other — no other God.' "

verses.kjv: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
verses.modern: Truly, You are a God Who hides Himself, O God of Israel, the Savior.

verses.kjv: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.
verses.modern: All of them are put to shame and disgraced; together they go in disgrace — the makers of idols.

verses.kjv: But Israel shall be saved in the LORD with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
verses.modern: But Israel is saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation. You shall not be put to shame or disgraced forever and ever.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the LORD; and there is none else.
verses.modern: For thus says the LORD — who created the heavens, who is God, Who formed the earth and made it, who established it, who did not create it empty but formed it to be inhabited: "I am the LORD, and there is no other.

verses.kjv: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
verses.modern: I did not speak in secret, in a land of darkness. I did not say to the offspring of Jacob, 'Seek Me in vain.' I the LORD speak the truth; I declare what is right.

verses.kjv: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.
verses.modern: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, You survivors of the nations! They have no knowledge who carry about their wooden idols and keep on praying to a god that cannot save.

verses.kjv: Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the LORD? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.
verses.modern: Declare and present Your case. Let them take counsel together. Who told this long ago? Who declared it of old? Was it not I, the LORD? There is no other God besides Me — a righteous God and a Savior. There is none besides Me.

verses.kjv: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.
verses.modern: Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no other.

verses.kjv: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
verses.modern: By Myself I have sworn — from My mouth has gone out in righteousness a word that shall not return: "To Me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear allegiance."

verses.kjv: Surely, shall one say, in the LORD have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.
verses.modern: Only in the LORD, it shall be said of Me, are righteousness and strength. To Him shall come and be ashamed all who were angry with Him.

verses.kjv: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
verses.modern: In the LORD all the offspring of Israel shall be justified and shall glory.

chapters.summary: The LORD speaks to Cyrus His anointed, whom He has called by name though Cyrus does not know Him. The LORD declares that He forms the light and creates darkness, makes peace and creates evil. He commands the heavens to drop down righteousness and declares that every knee shall bow to Him and every tongue shall swear allegiance.

verses.kjv: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast.
verses.modern: Bel bows down; Nebo stoops. Their idols are loaded on animals, on beasts of burden. The things You carry are heavy loads — a burden for weary animals.

verses.kjv: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
verses.modern: They stoop and bow down together. They cannot save the burden; they themselves go into captivity.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
verses.modern: Listen to Me, O house of Jacob, all the remnant of the house of Israel — you whom I have carried since birth, whom I have held since you came from the womb.

verses.kjv: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
verses.modern: Even to your old age I am He. Even when your hair is gray I will carry you. I have made you, and I will bear you. I will carry you and deliver you.

verses.kjv: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
verses.modern: To whom will you liken Me and make Me equal? Who can you compare Me to, that we should be alike?

verses.kjv: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
verses.modern: They pour out gold from a pouch and weigh silver on the scales. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it into a god. Then they fall down and worship it.

verses.kjv: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
verses.modern: They carry it on their shoulders; they haul it and set it in its place, and there it stands. It cannot move from its spot. If one cries out to it, it does not answer. It cannot save anyone from trouble.

verses.kjv: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
verses.modern: Remember this and stand firm. Take it to heart, you who have turned away.

verses.kjv: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me,
verses.modern: Remember the things of old — what happened long ago. I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like Me.

verses.kjv: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:
verses.modern: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things not yet done. I say, "My purpose shall stand, and I will accomplish all My plan."

verses.kjv: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.
verses.modern: I call a bird of prey from the east — the man of My purpose from a distant land. I have spoken, and I will bring it to pass. I have planned it, and I will do it.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:
verses.modern: Listen to Me, you stubborn of heart, you who are far from righteousness.

verses.kjv: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.
verses.modern: I bring My righteousness near; it is not far off. My salvation will not be delayed. I will place salvation in Zion, and My glory in Israel.

chapters.summary: The LORD contrasts Himself with the gods of Babylon -- Bel bows down and Nebo stoops, carried as burdens on weary beasts. But the LORD has carried Israel from the womb and will carry them to old age. He calls a bird of prey from the east to accomplish His purpose, and His salvation shall not delay.

verses.kjv: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.
verses.modern: Come down and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon. Sit on the ground, for there is no throne for You — daughter of the Chaldeans. You will no longer be called tender and delicate.

verses.kjv: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
verses.modern: Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove Your veil; strip off Your skirt and bare Your leg; wade through the rivers.

verses.kjv: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.
verses.modern: Your nakedness will be exposed. Your shame will be seen. I will take vengeance, and I will spare no one.

verses.kjv: As for our redeemer, the LORD of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.modern: Our Redeemer — the LORD of hosts is His name — is the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
verses.modern: Sit in silence. Go into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans. For you will no longer be called mistress of kingdoms.

verses.kjv: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.
verses.modern: I was angry with My people. I profaned My inheritance and handed them over to You. But You showed them no mercy. You laid a heavy yoke even on the elderly.

verses.kjv: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.
verses.modern: You said, "I will be queen forever." You did not take these things to heart; You did not think about how it would end.

verses.kjv: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
verses.modern: So now listen to this, You lover of pleasure, who live so carelessly and say in Your heart, "I am, and there is no one besides me. I will never be a widow; I will never lose my children."

verses.kjv: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.
verses.modern: Both of these shall come on You in a single day — the loss of children and widowhood. They shall come in full measure, despite Your many sorceries and the great power of Your spells.

verses.kjv: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.
verses.modern: You felt secure in Your wickedness and said, "No one sees me." Your wisdom and your knowledge led You astray. You said in Your heart, "I am, and there is no one besides me."

verses.kjv: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.
verses.modern: So disaster shall come upon You, and You will not know how to charm it away. Calamity shall fall on You, and You will not be able to ward it off. Ruin shall come on You suddenly, before You know it.

verses.kjv: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.
verses.modern: Keep on with Your spells and Your many sorceries, at which You have labored since Your youth. Perhaps You will succeed; perhaps You will strike fear into enemies.

verses.kjv: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.
verses.modern: You are worn out with all Your advisers. Let them stand up now — those who gaze at the stars, who study the sky each month and predict what will happen to You. Let them save You from what is coming.

verses.kjv: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.
verses.modern: They are like stubble. Fire will burn them up. They cannot save themselves from the power of the flame. This is no fire to warm Yourself at — no coals to sit beside.

verses.kjv: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.
verses.modern: So too will Your traders be — those You have worked with since Your youth. They will wander off, each going His own way. None of them will save You.

chapters.summary: The LORD pronounces judgment on the virgin daughter of Babylon, who will come down from her throne and sit in the dust. She trusted in her wickedness and said, 'No one sees me.' Disaster will come on her suddenly. Her astrologers and stargazers cannot save her from the fire that will consume her.

verses.kjv: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
verses.modern: Listen to this, O house of Jacob — you who are called by the name of Israel and came from the line of Judah. You swear by the name of the LORD and call on the God of Israel, but not in truth or in righteousness.

verses.kjv: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The LORD of hosts is his name.
verses.modern: They call themselves citizens of the holy city and lean on the God of Israel — the LORD of hosts is His name.

verses.kjv: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.
verses.modern: I declared the former things long ago. They went out from My mouth; I made them known. Then I acted suddenly, and they came to pass.

verses.kjv: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;
verses.modern: I knew that You are stubborn — your neck is an iron tendon and Your forehead is bronze.

verses.kjv: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
verses.modern: Therefore I told You these things long ago. Before they came to pass I declared them to You, so that You could not say, "My idol did them; my carved image or my cast idol commanded them."

verses.kjv: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.
verses.modern: You have heard these things; look at all of them! Will You not declare it? From this time on I announce new things to You — hidden things You have not known.

verses.kjv: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.
verses.modern: They are created now and not long ago; before today You had not heard of them, so that You could not say, "I already knew them."

verses.kjv: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.modern: You had not heard; You did not know; Your ear was not opened long ago. For I knew that You would deal very treacherously. You were called a rebel from birth.

verses.kjv: For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
verses.modern: For My name's sake I hold back My anger; for the sake of My praise I restrain it for You, so that I do not cut You off.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
verses.modern: I have refined You, but not as silver is refined. I have tried You in the furnace of affliction.

verses.kjv: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
verses.modern: For My own sake — for My own sake — I do this. How can My name be dishonored? I will not give My glory to another.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
verses.modern: Listen to Me, O Jacob, and Israel, whom I have called. I am he. I am the first, and I am the last.

verses.kjv: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.
verses.modern: My hand laid the foundation of the earth. My right hand spread out the heavens. When I call to them, they stand up together.

verses.kjv: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? The LORD hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
verses.modern: Come together and listen, all of You. Which of the idols declared these things? The LORD loves Him. He will carry out His purpose against Babylon; His arm will be against the Chaldeans.

verses.kjv: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
verses.modern: I, I have spoken. I have called Him, I have brought Him, and His way will succeed.

verses.kjv: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent me.
verses.modern: Come near to Me; listen to this. From the beginning I have not spoken in secret. From the time it came to be, I was there. And now the Lord GOD has sent Me, along with His Spirit.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go:
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD, Your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the LORD Your God, who teaches You what is good for You, who leads You in the way You should go.

verses.kjv: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
verses.modern: If only You had listened to My commandments! Then Your peace would have been like a river, and Your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

verses.kjv: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
verses.modern: Your descendants would have been as numerous as the sand, and Your children as countless as its grains. Their name would never be cut off or destroyed from My presence.

verses.kjv: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
verses.modern: Go out from Babylon; flee from the Chaldeans! Declare this with shouts of joy; proclaim it and send it out to the end of the earth. Say, "The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob!"

verses.kjv: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
verses.modern: They did not thirst when He led them through the deserts. He made water flow for them from the rock; He split the rock and the waters gushed out.

verses.kjv: There is no peace, saith the LORD, unto the wicked.
verses.modern: "There is no peace," says the LORD, "for the wicked."

chapters.summary: The LORD rebukes Israel for swearing by His name without truth or righteousness. He declared former things long ago so they could not credit their idols. For His own name's sake He delays His anger, and He refines Israel in the furnace of affliction. He commands them to go forth from Babylon and declares there is no peace for the wicked.

verses.kjv: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.
verses.modern: Listen to Me, O coastlands; pay attention, You peoples from far away. The LORD called Me from the womb; He named Me from my mother's body.

verses.kjv: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;
verses.modern: He made My mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of His hand He hid Me. He made Me a polished arrow; in His quiver He concealed Me.

verses.kjv: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
verses.modern: He said to Me, "You are My servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified."

verses.kjv: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the LORD, and my work with my God.
