verses.modern: But I said, "I have labored in vain. I have spent My strength for nothing and emptiness. Yet surely My right is with the LORD, and My reward is with My God."

verses.kjv: And now, saith the LORD that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the LORD, and my God shall be my strength.
verses.modern: And now the LORD says — He who formed Me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob back to him and gather Israel to him, for I am honored in the eyes of the LORD, and My God has become My strength —

verses.kjv: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
verses.modern: He says: "It is too small a thing for you to be My servant, to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to restore the preserved ones of Israel. I will also make you a light for the Gentiles, that My salvation may reach to the end of the earth."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the LORD that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel — His Holy One — to One deeply despised, rejected by the nation, the servant of rulers: "Kings shall see and stand up; princes, and they shall bow down, because of the LORD, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen You."

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD: "In a time of favor I have answered You, and in a day of salvation I have helped You. I will keep You and make You a covenant to the people, to restore the land and to apportion the desolate inheritances,

verses.kjv: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.
verses.modern: saying to the prisoners, 'Come out,' and to those in darkness, 'Come into the light.' They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on all the bare heights.

verses.kjv: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
verses.modern: They shall not hunger or thirst; neither scorching heat nor sun shall strike them. For He who has mercy on them will lead them, and by springs of water He will guide them.

verses.kjv: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
verses.modern: I will make all My mountains into roads, and My highways shall be raised up.

verses.kjv: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
verses.modern: See, these shall come from far away — from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim.

verses.kjv: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the LORD hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
verses.modern: Sing for joy, O heavens; shout, O earth. Break out into song, O mountains! For the LORD has comforted His people and will have mercy on His afflicted.

verses.kjv: But Zion said, The LORD hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.
verses.modern: But Zion said, "The LORD has forsaken me; my Lord has forgotten me."

verses.kjv: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
verses.modern: Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should have no compassion on the son of her womb? Even if she could forget, I will not forget You.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
verses.modern: See, I have engraved You on the palms of My hands. Your walls are always before Me.

verses.kjv: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.
verses.modern: Your children hasten back. Those who destroyed You and laid You waste shall depart from You.

verses.kjv: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the LORD, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee, as a bride doeth.
verses.modern: Lift up Your eyes and look around — all of them gather and come to You. As I live, declares the LORD, You shall wear them all as an ornament; You shall put them on like a bride.

verses.kjv: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.
verses.modern: Your waste and desolate places — your ruined land — will surely now be too small for Your inhabitants, while those who swallowed You up are far away.

verses.kjv: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
verses.modern: The children born during Your time of bereavement will yet say in Your hearing, "The place is too cramped for me; make room for me to live."

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?
verses.modern: Then You will say in Your heart, "Who bore me these? I had lost my children; I was barren, exiled and put away. Who then raised these? I was left alone — where did these come from?"

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.
verses.modern: Thus says the Lord GOD: "I will lift up My hand to the nations and set up My ensign to the peoples. They shall bring Your sons in their arms, and Your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders.

verses.kjv: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
verses.modern: Kings shall be Your foster fathers, and their queens Your nursing mothers. They shall bow down to You with their faces to the ground and lick the dust of Your feet. Then You will know that I am the LORD; those who wait for Me shall not be put to shame."

verses.kjv: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, and the lawful captive delivered?
verses.modern: Can the prey be taken from the mighty man, or can the lawful captive be rescued?

verses.kjv: But thus saith the LORD, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.
verses.modern: But thus says the LORD: "Even the captives of a mighty man shall be taken away, and the prey of a tyrant shall be rescued. I will contend with those who contend with You, and I will save Your children.

verses.kjv: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.modern: I will make Your oppressors eat their own flesh, and they shall be drunk with their own blood as with new wine. Then all people will know that I am the LORD Your Savior, Your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob."

chapters.summary: The Servant of the LORD declares that the LORD called Him from the womb and made His mouth like a sharp sword. The LORD says it is too small a thing for the Servant to restore only Israel -- He will also be a light to the nations. Kings shall see and arise, and princes shall worship. Zion says the LORD has forsaken her, but the LORD answers that He has engraved her on the palms of His hands.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD: "Where is the certificate of divorce by which I sent Your mother away? Or to which of My creditors did I sell You? For Your iniquities You were sold, and for Your transgressions Your mother was sent away.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.
verses.modern: Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why did no one answer? Is My hand shortened so that it cannot redeem? Do I have no power to deliver? At My rebuke I dry up the sea; I make rivers a desert. Their fish rot because there is no water; they die of thirst.

verses.kjv: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
verses.modern: I clothe the heavens with darkness and make sackcloth their covering."

verses.kjv: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
verses.modern: The Lord GOD has given Me the tongue of those who are taught, so that I may know how to sustain the weary with a word. Morning by morning He wakens; He wakens My ear to listen as those who are taught.

verses.kjv: The Lord GOD hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
verses.modern: The Lord GOD has opened My ear, and I was not rebellious; I did not turn away.

verses.kjv: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
verses.modern: I gave My back to those who struck Me and My cheeks to those who pulled out the beard. I did not hide My face from shame and spitting.

verses.kjv: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
verses.modern: For the Lord GOD will help Me; therefore I will not be put to shame. I have set My face like a flint, and I know I will not be disgraced.

verses.kjv: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
verses.modern: He who vindicates Me is near. Who will bring charges against Me? Let us face each other. Who is My accuser? Let Him come near.

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
verses.modern: The Lord GOD will help Me. Who will declare Me guilty? All of them will wear out like a garment; the moth will eat them.

verses.kjv: Who is among you that feareth the LORD, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD, and stay upon his God.
verses.modern: Who among You fears the LORD and obeys the voice of His servant? Who walks in darkness and has no light? Let Him trust in the name of the LORD and rely on His God.

verses.kjv: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
verses.modern: All You who kindle a fire and equip yourselves with flaming torches — walk in the light of Your fire and among the torches You have set ablaze. This is what You shall receive from My hand: You shall lie down in torment.

chapters.summary: The LORD asks where the certificate of Israel's divorce is and declares that His arm is not shortened that it cannot save. The Servant of the LORD sets His face like flint and gives His back to those who strike Him and His cheeks to those who pluck out the beard. He trusts in the LORD and is not ashamed.

verses.kjv: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the LORD: look unto the rock whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged.
verses.modern: Listen to Me, You who pursue righteousness, You who seek the LORD. Look to the rock from which You were cut and to the quarry from which You were dug.

verses.kjv: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.
verses.modern: Look to Abraham your father and to Sarah who bore you. I called him alone and blessed him and made him many.

verses.kjv: For the LORD shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
verses.modern: For the LORD will comfort Zion; He will comfort all her desolate places. He will make her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in her — thanksgiving and the sound of singing.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
verses.modern: Listen to Me, My people; give ear to Me, My nation. A law will go out from Me, and My justice shall be a light to the peoples.

verses.kjv: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.
verses.modern: My righteousness is near; My salvation has gone out; My arms will judge the peoples. The coastlands wait for Me, and in My arm they put their hope.

verses.kjv: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
verses.modern: Lift up Your eyes to the heavens and look at the earth beneath. The heavens shall vanish like smoke; the earth shall wear out like a garment; its inhabitants shall die like gnats. But My salvation will be forever, and My righteousness will never fail.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
verses.modern: Listen to Me, You who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is My law. Do not fear the reproach of men; do not be dismayed at their insults.

verses.kjv: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.
verses.modern: For the moth shall eat them like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool. But My righteousness shall be forever, and My salvation to all generations.

verses.kjv: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
verses.modern: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD. Awake as in the days of old, the generations of long ago. Was it not You who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the dragon?

verses.kjv: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
verses.modern: Was it not You who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep — who made the depths of the sea a road for the ransomed to cross over?

verses.kjv: Therefore the redeemed of the LORD shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.
verses.modern: So the redeemed of the LORD shall return and come to Zion with singing. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They shall obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

verses.kjv: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of man which shall be made as grass;
verses.modern: I, I am He who comforts you. Why then do you fear a man who is mortal — the son of man who is made like grass?

verses.kjv: And forgettest the LORD thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?
verses.modern: You have forgotten the LORD Your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth. You live in constant terror all day long because of the fury of the oppressor who is bent on destruction. But where is the fury of the oppressor now?

verses.kjv: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
verses.modern: The captive who crouches shall quickly be set free. He shall not die in the pit; His food shall not run out.

verses.kjv: But I am the LORD thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts is his name.
verses.modern: For I am the LORD Your God, Who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. The LORD of hosts is His name.

verses.kjv: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.
verses.modern: I have put My words in Your mouth and covered You in the shadow of My hand — stretching out the heavens and laying the foundations of the earth, and saying to Zion, "You are My people."

verses.kjv: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.
verses.modern: Wake up, wake up! Rise up, O Jerusalem — you who have drunk from the hand of the LORD the cup of His wrath. You have drunk to the dregs the cup that makes men stagger.

verses.kjv: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up.
verses.modern: There is no one to guide her — none of all the children she has borne. There is no one to take her by the hand — none of all the children she has raised.

verses.kjv: These two things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?
verses.modern: These two things have come on You — who will grieve with You? — devastation and destruction, famine and sword. By whom shall I comfort You?

verses.kjv: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the LORD, the rebuke of thy God.
verses.modern: Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street like an antelope caught in a net. They are full of the wrath of the LORD, the rebuke of Your God.

verses.kjv: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
verses.modern: So listen to this, You afflicted one, drunk — but not with wine.

verses.kjv: Thus saith thy Lord the LORD, and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:
verses.modern: Thus says Your Lord, the LORD — your God Who defends His people: "I am taking from Your hand the cup that made You stagger, the dregs of My cup of wrath. You shall never drink it again.

verses.kjv: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.
verses.modern: I will put it into the hand of Your tormentors, who said to You, 'Bow down so we can walk over You.' You made Your back like the ground and like a street for them to walk on."

chapters.summary: The LORD calls those who pursue righteousness to look to Abraham and Sarah, from whom He called a nation out of one man. He will comfort Zion and make her wilderness like Eden. Israel is told to awake and put on strength; the cup of the LORD's fury that made them stagger will be taken from their hand and put into the hand of their tormentors.

verses.kjv: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.
verses.modern: Wake up, wake up! Put on Your strength, O Zion. Put on Your beautiful clothes, O Jerusalem, the holy city. The uncircumcised and the unclean shall enter you no more.

verses.kjv: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
verses.modern: Shake Yourself free from the dust; arise and take Your seat, O Jerusalem. Loose the bonds from your neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.
verses.modern: For thus says the LORD: "You were sold for nothing, and You shall be redeemed without money."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
verses.modern: For thus says the Lord GOD: "My people went down to Egypt at the start to stay there, and the Assyrian oppressed them for nothing.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the LORD, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the LORD; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.
verses.modern: Now what do I have here?" declares the LORD. "My people are taken away for nothing. Those who rule over them wail," declares the LORD, "and My name is continually despised all day long.

verses.kjv: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak: behold, it is I.
verses.modern: Therefore My people shall know My name. In that day they shall know that it is I who speak; here I am."

verses.kjv: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
verses.modern: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of Him who brings good news — who announces peace, who brings good news of good things, who announces salvation, who says to Zion, "Your God reigns!"

verses.kjv: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.
verses.modern: Your watchmen lift up their voices; together they sing for joy. For eye to eye they shall see the LORD returning to Zion.

verses.kjv: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the LORD hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Break forth together into singing, You waste places of Jerusalem! For the LORD has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.
verses.modern: The LORD has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations. All the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.

verses.kjv: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the LORD.
verses.modern: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch nothing unclean. Go out from the middle of her; purify yourselves, You who carry the vessels of the LORD.

verses.kjv: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your rereward.
verses.modern: For You shall not go out in haste, and You shall not go in flight. For the LORD will go before You, and the God of Israel will be Your rear guard.

verses.kjv: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
verses.modern: See, My servant shall act wisely. He shall be raised up and lifted high and greatly exalted.

verses.kjv: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
verses.modern: Just as many were appalled at Him — His appearance was so disfigured beyond that of any man, and His form beyond human likeness —

verses.kjv: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.
verses.modern: so He shall sprinkle many nations. Kings shall shut their mouths because of Him. For what they were not told they shall see, and what they had not heard they shall understand.

chapters.summary: The LORD commands Zion to awake and put on her beautiful garments, for the uncircumcised and unclean shall no longer come into her. How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good tidings of peace. The LORD's Servant shall be exalted and extolled, yet His appearance was marred more than any man, and He shall sprinkle many nations.

verses.kjv: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?
verses.modern: Who has believed what He heard from us? To whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?

verses.kjv: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
verses.modern: He grew up before God like a tender shoot, like a root out of dry ground. He had no form or majesty that we should look at Him, and no beauty that we should desire Him.

verses.kjv: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
verses.modern: He is despised and rejected of men — a man of sorrows, acquainted with grief. We hid our faces from Him; He was despised, and we did not esteem Him.

verses.kjv: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
verses.modern: Surely He has borne our griefs and carried our sorrows. Yet we thought He was stricken, struck down by God, and afflicted.

verses.kjv: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
verses.modern: But He was wounded for our transgressions; He was bruised for our iniquities. The chastisement of our peace was upon Him, and with His stripes we are healed.

verses.kjv: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.modern: All we like sheep have gone astray. Each of us has turned to his own way. The LORD has laid on Him the iniquity of us all.

verses.kjv: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
verses.modern: He was oppressed and He was afflicted, yet He did not open His mouth. He is brought as a lamb to the slaughter. As a sheep before its shearers is silent, so He did not open His mouth.

verses.kjv: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
verses.modern: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. Who will declare His generation? He was cut off from the land of the living. For the transgression of My people He was stricken.

verses.kjv: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.
verses.modern: He was assigned a grave with the wicked and with a rich man in his death, because He had done no violence and there was no deceit in His mouth.

verses.kjv: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.
verses.modern: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise Him; He has put Him to grief. When You shall make His soul an offering for sin, He shall see His offspring; He shall prolong His days. The purpose of the LORD shall prosper in His hand.

verses.kjv: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
verses.modern: Out of the anguish of His soul He shall see and be satisfied. By His knowledge My righteous servant shall justify many, for He shall bear their iniquities.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
verses.modern: Therefore I will give Him a portion among the great, and He shall divide the spoil with the strong. Because He poured out His soul to death and was numbered with the transgressors, He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors.

chapters.summary: Isaiah prophesies the suffering Servant, despised and rejected of men, a man of sorrows acquainted with grief. He was wounded for our transgressions and bruised for our iniquities; the chastisement of our peace was upon Him, and with His stripes we are healed. All we like sheep have gone astray, and the LORD has laid on Him the iniquity of us all. He is led as a lamb to the slaughter, and by His knowledge He shall justify many.

verses.kjv: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: Sing, O barren woman — you who did not give birth! Break out into song and cry aloud, You who have never been in labor! For the children of the desolate woman will be more than the children of the married wife, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
verses.modern: Enlarge the place of Your tent; let the curtains of Your dwelling be stretched out wide. Do not hold back — lengthen Your ropes and drive Your stakes deep.

verses.kjv: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
verses.modern: For You will spread out to the right and to the left. Your descendants shall possess the nations and will settle the desolate cities.

verses.kjv: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
verses.modern: Do not fear, for You will not be ashamed. Do not be dismayed, for You will not be disgraced. You will forget the shame of Your youth, and You will no longer remember the reproach of Your widowhood.

verses.kjv: For thy Maker is thine husband; the LORD of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.
verses.modern: For Your Maker is Your husband — the LORD of hosts is His name. Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel. He shall be called the God of all the earth.

verses.kjv: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
verses.modern: For the LORD has called You like a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit — like a young wife when You were rejected, says Your God.

verses.kjv: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
verses.modern: For a brief moment I abandoned You, but with great mercies I will gather You.

verses.kjv: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.
verses.modern: In a surge of anger I hid My face from You for a moment. But with everlasting kindness I will have mercy on You, says the LORD Your Redeemer.

verses.kjv: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
verses.modern: For this is like the days of Noah to Me. As I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, and will not rebuke you.

verses.kjv: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
verses.modern: For the mountains may depart and the hills be removed, but My kindness shall not depart from You. My covenant of peace shall not be removed, says the LORD Who has mercy on You.

verses.kjv: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
verses.modern: O afflicted city — storm-tossed and not comforted — I will set Your stones in beautiful colors and lay Your foundations with sapphires.

verses.kjv: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
verses.modern: I will make Your battlements of rubies, Your gates of jewels, and all Your walls of precious stones.

verses.kjv: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
verses.modern: All Your children shall be taught by the LORD, and great shall be the peace of Your children.

verses.kjv: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.
verses.modern: You shall be established in righteousness. You shall be far from oppression — you shall not fear. You shall be far from terror — it shall not come near You.

verses.kjv: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.
verses.modern: If anyone stirs up strife, it is not from Me. Whoever gathers against you shall fall because of you.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
verses.modern: I have created the craftsman who blows the fire of coals and produces a weapon for His purpose. I have also created the destroyer to cause ruin.

verses.kjv: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: No weapon formed against You shall succeed. Every tongue that rises against You in judgment You shall refute. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is from Me, declares the LORD.

chapters.summary: The LORD calls the barren woman to sing, for her children will be more than those of the married woman. Her Maker is her husband -- the LORD of hosts is His name -- and He calls her back like a wife forsaken. No weapon formed against her shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against her in judgment she shall condemn.

verses.kjv: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
verses.modern: Come, everyone who is thirsty — come to the waters! Even He who has no money — come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost.

verses.kjv: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
verses.modern: Why do You spend money for what is not bread, and Your wages for what does not satisfy? Listen carefully to Me and eat what is good. Let Your soul delight in rich food.

verses.kjv: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
verses.modern: Turn your ear and come to Me; listen, that your soul may live! I will make an everlasting covenant with you — the faithful mercies shown to David.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.
verses.modern: I have made him a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander for the peoples.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the LORD thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.
verses.modern: You shall call a nation You do not know, and a nation that did not know You shall run to You — because of the LORD Your God, the Holy One of Israel, for He has glorified You.

verses.kjv: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
verses.modern: Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.

verses.kjv: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the LORD, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
verses.modern: Let the wicked forsake his way and the unrighteous man His thoughts. Let Him return to the LORD, and He will have mercy on Him — to our God, for He will freely pardon.

verses.kjv: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: "For My thoughts are not Your thoughts, and Your ways are not My ways," declares the LORD.

verses.kjv: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.modern: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are My ways higher than Your ways and My thoughts than Your thoughts.

verses.kjv: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:
verses.modern: For as the rain and the snow come down from heaven and do not return there, but water the earth and make it bring forth and sprout — giving seed to the sower and bread to the eater —

verses.kjv: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
verses.modern: so shall My word be that goes out from My mouth. It shall not return to Me empty; it shall accomplish what I desire and succeed in the thing for which I sent it.

verses.kjv: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
verses.modern: For You shall go out with joy and be led forth with peace. The mountains and the hills shall break out into singing before You, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.

verses.kjv: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the LORD for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.
verses.modern: Instead of the thorn shall come up the cypress tree; instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle. This shall be a memorial to the LORD, an everlasting sign that shall not be removed.

chapters.summary: The LORD invites everyone who thirsts to come to the waters and buy wine and milk without money and without price. He will make an everlasting covenant with His people -- the sure mercies of David. His thoughts are higher than man's thoughts, and His word shall not return to Him void but shall accomplish what He pleases.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
verses.modern: Thus says the LORD: "Keep justice and do righteousness, for My salvation is near to come and My righteousness to be revealed."

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.
verses.modern: Blessed is the man who does this — the son of man who holds it firmly — who keeps the Sabbath without defiling it, and keeps His hand from doing any evil.

verses.kjv: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the LORD, speak, saying, The LORD hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.
verses.modern: Let not the foreigner who has joined Himself to the LORD say, "The LORD will surely exclude me from His people." Let not the eunuch say, "I am a dry tree."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;
verses.modern: For thus says the LORD to the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, who choose what pleases Me and hold fast to My covenant:

verses.kjv: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
verses.modern: "I will give them a memorial and a name within My house and within My walls, better than sons and daughters. I will give them an everlasting name that shall not be cut off."

verses.kjv: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the LORD, to serve him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;
verses.modern: And the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD — to serve Him, to love the name of the LORD, and to be His servants — everyone who keeps the Sabbath without defiling it and holds fast to My covenant —

verses.kjv: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
verses.modern: even them I will bring to My holy mountain and make them joyful in My house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and sacrifices shall be accepted on My altar. For My house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples.

verses.kjv: The Lord GOD which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
verses.modern: The Lord GOD, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, declares: "I will gather still others to Him besides those already gathered."

verses.kjv: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.
verses.modern: Come to devour, all You animals of the field — all You animals in the forest.

verses.kjv: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
verses.modern: His watchmen are blind; they are all without knowledge. They are all silent dogs that cannot bark. They lie down and love to sleep.

verses.kjv: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.
verses.modern: They are greedy dogs with an insatiable appetite. They are shepherds who have no understanding. They all look to their own way, each one seeking his own gain.

verses.kjv: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.
verses.modern: "Come," each one cries, "let me bring wine; let us drink our fill of strong drink. Tomorrow will be like today — even better!"

chapters.summary: The LORD declares that His salvation is near and commands justice and righteousness. The foreigner who joins himself to the LORD shall not be separated from His people, and the eunuch who keeps the LORD's sabbaths will be given a name better than sons and daughters. The LORD's house will be called a house of prayer for all people. Israel's watchmen are blind and her shepherds cannot understand.

verses.kjv: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.
verses.modern: The righteous man perishes, and no one takes it to heart. Godly men are taken away, with no one realizing that the righteous man is taken away from the evil that is coming.

verses.kjv: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.
verses.modern: He enters into peace. They rest in their places — each one who walked in his uprightness.

verses.kjv: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
verses.modern: But come here, you children of a sorceress — you offspring of the adulterer and the prostitute.

verses.kjv: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
verses.modern: Who are you mocking? Against whom do you open your mouth wide and stick out your tongue? Are you not children of transgression, offspring of deceit?

verses.kjv: Inflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, burning your children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
verses.modern: You burn with lust among the oaks and under every green tree. You sacrifice your children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks.

verses.kjv: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
verses.modern: Among the smooth stones of the stream is your portion; they are your lot. To them you have poured out drink offerings and have made grain offerings. Shall I relent for these things?

verses.kjv: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
verses.modern: On a high and lofty mountain you made your bed. You went up there to offer your sacrifices.

verses.kjv: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.
verses.modern: Behind the door and the doorpost you have put your symbol. Turning from Me, you uncovered yourself to another and went up. You enlarged your bed and made a bargain with them. You loved their bed; you chose their open company.

verses.kjv: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.
verses.modern: You journeyed to the king with oil and lavished your perfumes. You sent your ambassadors far away; you sent them down even to the grave.

verses.kjv: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
verses.modern: You were worn out by your many journeys, but you did not say, "It is hopeless." You found renewed strength, and so you were not discouraged.

verses.kjv: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
verses.modern: Whom have you feared and been in awe of, that you have lied and not remembered Me, not taken Me to heart? Was I not silent for a long time, and so you do not fear Me?

verses.kjv: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.
verses.modern: I will expose your so-called righteousness and your deeds — they will not help you.

verses.kjv: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
verses.modern: When you cry out, let your collection of idols deliver you! But the wind will carry them all away; a breath will take them. But he who takes refuge in Me shall possess the land and shall inherit My holy mountain.

verses.kjv: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
verses.modern: He shall say: "Build up, build up — prepare the way! Remove every stumbling block from the road for My people."

verses.kjv: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
verses.modern: For thus says the One who is high and lifted up — who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: "I live in the high and holy place, and also with the one who is contrite and humble in spirit — to revive the spirit of the humble and to revive the heart of the contrite."

verses.kjv: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
verses.modern: For I will not contend forever, nor will I always be angry. For the spirit would grow faint before Me — the souls I have made.

verses.kjv: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
verses.modern: Because of his iniquitous covetousness I was angry; I struck him and hid My face in anger. But he kept going back to the ways of his own heart.

verses.kjv: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
verses.modern: I have seen his ways, but I will heal him. I will lead him and restore comfort to him and his mourners.

verses.kjv: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him.
verses.modern: I create the fruit of the lips. Peace, peace to the one who is far and to the one who is near, says the LORD. I will heal Him.

verses.kjv: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
verses.modern: But the wicked are like the troubled sea — it cannot be quiet, and its waters toss up mud and mire.

verses.kjv: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.
verses.modern: "There is no peace," says my God, "for the wicked."

chapters.summary: The righteous perish and no one takes it to heart. The LORD rebukes the idolaters who sacrifice children in the valleys and set up their bed on every high mountain. But to the contrite and humble spirit the LORD gives life, for He will not contend forever. He creates the fruit of the lips -- peace to him who is far off and to him who is near. There is no peace for the wicked.

verses.kjv: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.modern: Cry out loudly; do not hold back! Lift up your voice like a trumpet. Declare to My people their transgression and to the house of Jacob their sins.

verses.kjv: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.
verses.modern: Yet they seek Me daily and delight to know My ways, as if they were a nation that did righteousness and did not forsake the ordinances of their God. They ask Me for just decisions; they delight in drawing near to God.

verses.kjv: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
verses.modern: "Why have we fasted and You do not see?" they say. "Why have we humbled ourselves and You take no notice?" Look — on the day of your fasting you pursue your own pleasure and oppress all your workers.

verses.kjv: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
verses.modern: You fast for strife and argument and to strike with a wicked fist. You do not fast as you do this day if you want your voice to be heard on high.

verses.kjv: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?
verses.modern: Is this the fast I have chosen — a day for a man to humble himself? Is it to bow his head like a reed and to spread sackcloth and ashes? Will You call this a fast — a day acceptable to the LORD?

verses.kjv: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
verses.modern: Is this not the fast I have chosen: to break the chains of injustice and untie the cords of the yoke — to set the oppressed free and to break every yoke?

verses.kjv: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
verses.modern: Is it not to share Your bread with the hungry and to bring the homeless poor into Your house — to cover the naked when You see them and not to turn away from Your own kin?

verses.kjv: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rereward.
verses.modern: Then Your light shall break out like the dawn. Your healing shall spring up quickly. Your righteousness shall go before You; the glory of the LORD shall be Your rear guard.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou call, and the LORD shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
verses.modern: Then You shall call, and the LORD will answer. You shall cry, and He will say, "Here I am." If You remove the yoke from Your midst, the pointing of the finger, and speaking wickedness,

verses.kjv: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noon day:
verses.modern: and if You pour Yourself out for the hungry and satisfy the desire of the afflicted — then Your light shall rise in the darkness, and Your gloom shall be as the noonday.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
verses.modern: The LORD will guide You continually and satisfy Your soul in dry times and make Your bones strong. You shall be like a watered garden, like a spring of water whose waters do not fail.

verses.kjv: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
verses.modern: Your people shall build up the ancient ruins; You shall raise up the age-old foundations. You shall be called the Repairer of the Breach, the Restorer of Streets to dwell in.

verses.kjv: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the LORD, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:
verses.modern: If You turn back Your foot from the Sabbath — from doing Your pleasure on My holy day — and call the Sabbath a delight and the LORD's holy day honorable; if You honor it by not going Your own ways or seeking Your own pleasure or speaking Your own words,

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.modern: then You shall take delight in the LORD. I will make You ride on the heights of the earth; I will feed You with the heritage of Jacob your father. The mouth of the LORD has spoken.

chapters.summary: The LORD rebukes Israel's fasts as empty rituals done for show while they oppress their workers. The true fast is to loose the bonds of wickedness, feed the hungry, clothe the naked, and take in the homeless poor. Then their light will break forth as the morning, and the LORD will guide them continually and satisfy their soul in drought.

verses.kjv: Behold, the LORD'S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
verses.modern: The LORD's arm is not too short to save; His ear is not too dull to hear.

verses.kjv: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
verses.modern: But Your iniquities have separated You from Your God. Your sins have hidden His face from You, so that He does not hear.

verses.kjv: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
verses.modern: Your hands are defiled with blood, Your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies; Your tongue mutters wickedness.

verses.kjv: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
verses.modern: No one calls for justice; no one pleads truthfully. They trust in empty talk and speak lies. They conceive trouble and give birth to iniquity.

verses.kjv: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
verses.modern: They hatch the eggs of vipers and spin a spider's web. Whoever eats their eggs dies, and when one is cracked, a poisonous snake hatches.

verses.kjv: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
verses.modern: Their webs cannot be used as clothing; their deeds cannot cover themselves. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands.

verses.kjv: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.
verses.modern: Their feet run to evil; they rush to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; ruin and destruction are in their paths.

verses.kjv: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
verses.modern: The way of peace they do not know; there is no justice in their paths. They have made their roads crooked; no one who walks on them knows peace.

verses.kjv: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
verses.modern: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We look for light, but find darkness; we look for brightness, but walk in deep shadow.

verses.kjv: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
verses.modern: We grope along the wall like the blind; we grope like those who have no eyes. We stumble at midday as in the twilight; among the healthy we are like the dead.

verses.kjv: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
verses.modern: We growl like bears; we moan mournfully like doves. We look for justice, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far from us.

verses.kjv: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
verses.modern: For our transgressions are many before You, and our sins testify against us. Our transgressions are with us, and we know our iniquities —

verses.kjv: In transgressing and lying against the LORD, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
verses.modern: transgressing and denying the LORD, turning away from our God — speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and speaking lies from the heart.

verses.kjv: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
verses.modern: Justice is turned back, and righteousness stands far away. Truth has stumbled in the public square, and honesty cannot enter.

verses.kjv: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.
verses.modern: Truth is missing; whoever turns from evil becomes a target. The LORD saw it, and it displeased Him that there was no justice.

verses.kjv: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
verses.modern: He saw that there was no man, and was appalled that there was no one to intercede. So his own arm brought salvation to Him, and His righteousness sustained Him.

verses.kjv: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.
verses.modern: He put on righteousness as a breastplate and a helmet of salvation on His head. He put on the garments of vengeance as His clothing, and wrapped Himself in zeal as a cloak.

verses.kjv: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
verses.modern: According to their deeds, so He will repay — wrath to His adversaries, repayment to His enemies. To the distant shores He will render repayment.

verses.kjv: So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.
verses.modern: So they shall fear the name of the LORD from the west, and His glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy comes in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up an ensign against Him.

verses.kjv: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.
verses.modern: The Redeemer shall come to Zion — to those in Jacob who turn from transgression, declares the LORD.

verses.kjv: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the LORD; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the LORD, from henceforth and for ever.
verses.modern: "And as for Me, this is My covenant with them," says the LORD: "My Spirit who is on You and My words that I have put in Your mouth shall not depart from Your mouth, or from the mouth of Your children, or from the mouth of Your children's children," says the LORD, "from now on and forever."

chapters.summary: Isaiah declares that the LORD's hand is not shortened that it cannot save, but Israel's iniquities have separated them from God. Justice is far from them, truth has fallen in the street, and the LORD saw that there was no intercessor, so His own arm brought salvation. The Redeemer shall come to Zion, and the LORD's covenant promises that His Spirit and His words shall not depart from their mouth forever.

verses.kjv: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
verses.modern: Arise, shine, for Your light has come! The glory of the LORD has risen on You.

verses.kjv: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
verses.modern: For darkness shall cover the earth and thick darkness the peoples, but the LORD will rise on You, and His glory will be seen on You.

verses.kjv: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
verses.modern: Nations shall come to Your light, and kings to the brightness of Your rising.

verses.kjv: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.
verses.modern: Lift up Your eyes and look around — all of them gather and come to You. Your sons shall come from far away, and Your daughters shall be carried at Your side.

verses.kjv: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.
verses.modern: Then You shall see and be radiant; Your heart shall thrill and overflow. For the wealth of the sea shall be brought to You; the riches of the nations shall come to you.

verses.kjv: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD.
verses.modern: A great number of camels shall cover You — the young camels of Midian and Ephah. All those from Sheba shall come; they shall bring gold and frankincense and shall proclaim the praises of the LORD.

verses.kjv: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.
verses.modern: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered to You; the rams of Nebaioth shall serve You. They shall come up with acceptance on My altar, and I will glorify My glorious house.

verses.kjv: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
verses.modern: Who are these who fly like a cloud, like doves to their perches?

verses.kjv: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the LORD thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.
verses.modern: Surely the coastlands wait for Me — the ships of Tarshish first — to bring Your sons from far away, their silver and gold with them, to the name of the LORD Your God, and to the Holy One of Israel, for He has glorified You.

verses.kjv: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.
verses.modern: Foreigners shall build Your walls, and their kings shall serve You. For in My anger I struck You, but in My favor I have had mercy on You.

verses.kjv: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.
verses.modern: Your gates shall always be open; day and night they shall not be shut — that people may bring You the wealth of the nations, with their kings being led in procession.

verses.kjv: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
verses.modern: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish. Those nations shall be completely destroyed.

verses.kjv: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
verses.modern: The glory of Lebanon shall come to You — the cypress, the plane tree, and the pine — to beautify the place of My sanctuary. I will make the place of My feet glorious.

verses.kjv: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the LORD, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.modern: The descendants of those who tormented You shall come bowing down to You. All who despised You shall bow at Your feet. They shall call You the City of the LORD, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
verses.modern: Because You have been forsaken and hated — with no one passing through — I will make you a pride forever, a joy from age to age.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.modern: You shall drink the milk of nations; You shall nurse at the breast of kings. You shall know that I, the LORD, am Your Savior and Your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

verses.kjv: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.
verses.modern: Instead of bronze I will bring gold; instead of iron I will bring silver; instead of wood, bronze; instead of stones, iron. I will make Your officers peace and Your rulers righteousness.

verses.kjv: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
verses.modern: Violence shall no more be heard in Your land, nor devastation or destruction within Your borders. You shall call Your walls Salvation and Your gates Praise.

verses.kjv: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the LORD shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
verses.modern: The sun shall no longer be Your light by day, nor shall the moon give You its brightness by night. But the LORD shall be Your everlasting light, and Your God shall be Your glory.

verses.kjv: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
verses.modern: Your sun shall no longer go down, and Your moon shall not withdraw. For the LORD shall be Your everlasting light, and the days of Your mourning shall be over.

verses.kjv: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
verses.modern: Your people shall all be righteous; they shall possess the land forever. They are the shoot of My planting, the work of My hands, that I may be glorified.

verses.kjv: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.
verses.modern: The smallest shall become a thousand, and the least shall become a mighty nation. I am the LORD; in its time I will do this quickly.

chapters.summary: Isaiah calls Zion to arise and shine, for her light has come and the glory of the LORD has risen upon her. Nations will come to her light and kings to the brightness of her rising. The wealth of the nations will flow to her, the sun will no longer be needed for light, and the LORD Himself will be her everlasting light.

verses.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
verses.modern: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to bring good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom to the captives and opening of the prison to those who are bound,

verses.kjv: To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
verses.modern: to proclaim the year of the LORD's favor and the day of vengeance of our God — to comfort all who mourn,

verses.kjv: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
verses.modern: to grant to those who mourn in Zion — to give them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of joy instead of mourning, the garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair. They shall be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He may be glorified.

verses.kjv: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
verses.modern: They shall build up the ancient ruins; they shall raise up the former desolations. They shall repair the ruined cities, the devastations of many generations.

verses.kjv: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
verses.modern: Strangers shall stand and tend Your flocks; foreigners shall be Your farmers and vinedressers.

verses.kjv: But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
verses.modern: But You shall be called the Priests of the LORD; You shall be spoken of as the Ministers of our God. You shall eat the wealth of the nations and in their riches you shall boast.

verses.kjv: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
verses.modern: Instead of your shame there shall be a double portion; instead of dishonor they shall rejoice in their lot. Therefore in their land they shall possess a double portion; everlasting joy shall be theirs.

verses.kjv: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.modern: For I the LORD love justice; I hate robbery and wrongdoing. I will faithfully give them their reward, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

verses.kjv: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the LORD hath blessed.
verses.modern: Their descendants shall be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them shall acknowledge them — that they are a people the LORD has blessed.

verses.kjv: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
verses.modern: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD; my soul shall be joyful in my God. For He has clothed me with garments of salvation; He has covered me with a robe of righteousness — as a bridegroom adorns Himself with a crown, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

verses.kjv: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
verses.modern: For as the earth brings forth its growth, and as a garden causes what is sown in it to sprout up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.

chapters.summary: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon the Servant to preach good tidings to the poor, to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and to declare the acceptable year of the LORD and the day of vengeance. The LORD will give them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness.

verses.kjv: For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.
verses.modern: For Zion's sake I will not keep silent, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not be still, until her righteousness goes out like brightness and her salvation burns like a torch.

verses.kjv: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.
